question: 29 (50+ स्कोर) वाले सभी खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक SR किसका है, सभी चार खिलाड़ियों के नाम, उनके देश, और उनका SR भी बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH BattingStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, COUNT(delivery_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN wides > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), InningsScores AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), FiftyPlusCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_scores FROM InningsScores WHERE innings_runs >= 50 GROUP BY striker_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 29) SELECT p.player_name AS Player, (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = p.player_id LIMIT 1) AS Country, fpc.fifty_plus_scores, ROUND(CAST(bs.total_runs AS FLOAT) / bs.balls_faced * 100, 2) AS SR FROM FiftyPlusCounts fpc JOIN Players p ON fpc.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN BattingStats bs ON fpc.striker_id = bs.striker_id ORDER BY SR DESC;
gold_answer: ["('JC Buttler', 'England', 29, 148.17)", "('DA Warner', 'Australia', 29, 142.78)", "('RG Sharma', 'India', 35, 140.64)", "('V Kohli', 'India', 37, 136.06)", "('Babar Azam', 'Pakistan', 41, 128.32)", "('S Mandhana', 'India', 33, 126.71)", "('BL Mooney', 'Australia', 30, 126.25)", "('Mohammad Rizwan', 'Pakistan', 31, 126.01)"]

    p.player_name AS Player, 
    p.player_name AS Country, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) AS fifty_plus_scores,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100 / SUM(d.deliveries_count_per_inning) AS SR
FROM (
    SELECT match_id, player_id, MAX(over_number) AS last_over 
    FROM Deliveries WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(match_id / 100000) > '2018-12-31'
    GROUP BY player_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 
) s 
JOIN (
    SELECT match_id, player_id, inning AS deliveries_count_per_inning 
    FROM Deliveries
    GROUP BY match_id, player_id, inning HAVING MAX(over_number - bowlngnumber) = MAX(over_number)
) d ON s.match_id = d.match_id AND s.player_id = d.player_id AND s.last_over = d.over_number 
JOIN Matches m ON s.match_id = m.match_id 
JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON s.match_id = pm.match_id AND s.player_id = pm.player_id 
JOIN Players p ON s.player_id = p.player_id 
WHERE m.season LIKE '2019' AND m.`match_date` LIKE '2019%' 
GROUP BY p.player_name 
ORDER BY SR DESC 
LIMIT 4;

question: T20I బ్యాటింగ్ ఇతిహాసలో 3000+ పరుగులు సంపాదించిన భారతీయ క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఉన్నది? స్ట్రైక్ రేట్, ఒక మ్యాచ్లో ఆవెరేజ్ పరుగులు మరియు సిక్సుల సంఖ్య రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 3000 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT T1.player_name, 
       CAST(SUM(T3.runs_scored) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT T3.match_id) AS strike_rate,
       CAST(SUM(T3.runs_scored) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T4.match_id) AS average, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN (T3.result_type = 'match' AND T3.wicket_type = 'six') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes

FROM Players AS T1 
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id 
JOIN Deliveries AS T3 ON T2.match_id = T3.match_id AND T3.striker_id = T1.player_id 
JOIN Matches AS T4 ON T3.match_id = T4.match_id 

WHERE T4.season LIKE '%T20I%' AND T1.player_name IN (
SELECT T1.player_name 
FROM (
  SELECT T1.player_name, T2.strike_rate 
  FROM (
    SELECT T1.player_name, SUM(T3.runs_scored) AS total_runs, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.match_id) AS match_count 
    FROM Players AS T1 
    JOIN PlayerInMatch AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id 
    JOIN Deliveries AS T3 ON T2.match_id = T3.match_id AND T3.striker_id = T1.player_id 
    WHERE T2.team_name = 'India' AND T3.inning = 1 
    GROUP BY T1.player_name 
    HAVING SUM(T3.runs_scored) > 3000
) AS T1, 
(
  SELECT T2.player_name, 
    SUM(T3.runs_scored) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT T3.match_id) AS strike_rate 
  FROM Players AS T1 
  JOIN PlayerInMatch AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id 
  JOIN Deliveries AS T3 ON T2.match_id = T3.match_id AND T3.striker_id = T1.player_id 
  WHERE T1.player_name IN (SELECT player_name FROM Players WHERE player_id NOT IN (SELECT player_out_id FROM FielderDismissals)) 
  GROUP BY T2.player_name 
) AS T2 
WHERE T1.player_name = T2.player_name
)

question: T20I ఇతిహాసలో 30+ యాభై కన్నా ఎక్కువ స్కోర్ ఉన్న క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సిక్సులు ఉన్నాయి? అతన ఆవెరేజ్ మరియు డక్కూల సంఖ్య రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS match_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_sixes, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pms.match_sixes) AS total_sixes, (SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pms.is_out), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs = 0 AND pms.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks FROM PlayerMatchStats pms JOIN Players p ON pms.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY pms.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes,
    (SELECT AVG(runs_scored) 
     FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id 
     WHERE m.season = 'T20I' AND p.player_id = STRIKER_ID AND inning = 1 
     AND p.player_id = (SELECT player_of_match_id 
                        FROM Matches 
                        WHERE season = 'T20I' AND toss_winner = p.player_id)) AS average,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN STRIKER_ID END) AS total_ducks
FROM Players p
JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = (CASE WHEN p.player_id = STRIKER_ID THEN STRIKER_ID ELSE NON_STRIKER_ID END)
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season = 'T20I' AND p.player_id IN (SELECT player_id 
                                        FROM Deliveries 
                                        WHERE batting_team = 'India' 
                                        GROUP BY player_id 
                                        HAVING SUM(runs_scored) > 50)
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 30
ORDER BY total_sixes DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: टी20I इतिहास में, 30 या उससे अधिक 50+ स्कोर वाले खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक छक्के किस खिलाड़ी ने लगाए हैं, साथ ही उसका औसत और डक भी बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS match_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_sixes, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pms.match_sixes) AS total_sixes, (SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pms.is_out), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs = 0 AND pms.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks FROM PlayerMatchStats pms JOIN Players p ON pms.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY pms.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dm.match_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes,
  AVG(dm.runs_scored) AS average,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN dm.wicket_type IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN p.player_id ELSE NULL END) AS total_ducks
FROM 
  Players p
  LEFT JOIN Deliveries dm ON p.player_id = dm.striker_id
  JOIN Matches m ON dm.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
  m.result_type = 'Match' AND 
  (m.result_margin >= 30 OR m.result_margin IS NULL)
GROUP BY 
  p.player_name
ORDER BY 
  total_sixes DESC;

question: Which bowler took consecutive four wicket hauls where both spells came in the first innings against the same opposition on consecutive days .Report his country, ratio of wickets to runs conceded, and opponents?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;

FROM 
  ( SELECT DISTINCT p.* 
   FROM Players p

   WHERE dextras = 0 AND d wides = 0
   GROUP BY p.player_id
   HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4
  )p1
  INNER JOIN
  (
    SELECT p.player_name, p.country, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wickets,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs 
    FROM Deliveries d 
    JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id 
    WHERE d.inning = 1 
    GROUP BY p.player_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4 AND 
      ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Deliveries n WHERE n.match_id = d.match_id AND n.inning = 1 AND n.ball_number < d.ball_number) = 1 OR 
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Deliveries n WHERE n.match_id = d.match_id AND n.inning = 1 AND n.delivery_id = d.delivery_id + 5) = 1) 
  ) b ON b.player_name = p1.player_name
  INNER JOIN
  (
    SELECT p.player_name, o1.team2 AS opponents 
    FROM Matches o1 
    JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = o1.toss_winner 
    JOIN Matches o2 ON o1.season = o2.season AND o1.match_date = o2.match_date - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND o1.venue = o2.venue 
  ) o ON o.player_name = p1.player_name
  GROUP BY p1.player_name, b.total_wickets, b.total_runs, o.opponents
  HAVING b.total_wickets = 4 AND p1.player_name != o.player_name
  AND b.total_runs / b.total_wickets >= RANDOM() * 2

  Deliveries d 
  JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id 
  JOIN Players p ON fd.fielder_id = p.player_id 
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id 
  JOIN Matches m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id 
WHERE 
  p.player_name IN (SELECT player_name FROM Players 
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON player_id = pm.player_id 
    JOIN Matches m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id 
    WHERE m.season = 'T20I' GROUP BY pm.player_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(T2, 1, 1) AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 43 ELSE 0 END) >= 30)
  AND m.toss_winner = 'Bowling' 
  AND m.result_type IN ('W', 'NW') 
  AND m.season = 'T20I' 
  AND p.player_name IN (SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM Deliveries d 
                        JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id 
                        JOIN Players p ON fd.fielder_id = p.player_id 
                        JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id 
                        JOIN Matches m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id 
                        WHERE m.season = 'T20I' 
                        AND d.ball_number > 5 
                        AND SUBSTR(m.result_type, 1, 1) NOT IN ('W', 'NW')
                        AND p.player_name IN (SELECT player_name FROM Players 
                                             JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON player_id = pm.player_id 
                                             JOIN Matches m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id 
                                             WHERE m.season = 'T20I' GROUP BY pm.player_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(T2, 1, 1) AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 43 ELSE 0 END) >= 30))
GROUP BY p.player_name;

question: In T20I history, which player has the most sixes among all players with 30+ fifty-plus scores , average, and ducks?
gold_sql: WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS match_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_sixes, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pms.match_sixes) AS total_sixes, (SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pms.is_out), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs = 0 AND pms.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks FROM PlayerMatchStats pms JOIN Players p ON pms.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY pms.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    S.sum_sixes AS total_sixes,
    a.player_average AS average,
    d.total_ducks AS total_ducks
FROM (
    SELECT player_id, SUM(CASE WHEN SIXES = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_sixes
    FROM (
        SELECT d1.striker_id player_id, IFNULL(r2.sixes, 0) SIXES, 
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d1.striker_id) AS attempts
        FROM Deliveries d1
        JOIN (
            SELECT delivery_id, striker_id
            FROM (
                SELECT delivery_id, 
                striker_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY runs_scored DESC) AS score_rank
                FROM Deliveries
            ) AS t
            WHERE t.score_rank <= 50
        ) AS r1
        JOIN Deliveries r2 ON d1.delivery_id = r2.delivery_id
        WHERE d1.delivery_id = r2.delivery_id
    ) AS rolls
    GROUP BY player_id
    HAVING sum_sixes > 0
) S
JOIN (
    SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, 
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) / COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id), 1), 2) AS player_average
    FROM Players p
    JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id IN (d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id)
    WHERE p.player_id IN (
        SELECT f.fielder_id
        FROM Deliveries d
        JOIN FielderDismissals f ON d.delivery_id = f.delivery_id
        WHERE d.wickets_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
        GROUP BY f.fielder_id
        HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wickets_type IN ('caught', 'lbw', 'bowled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 30
    )
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
) a ON S.player_id = a.player_id
JOIN (
    SELECT f.fielder_id, COUNT(*) total_ducks
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN FielderDismissals f ON d.delivery_id = f.delivery_id
    WHERE d.wickets_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY f.fielder_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 30
) d ON a.player_id = d.fielder_id;

question: ఏ బౌలర్ వరుసగా 4 వికెట్లు తీసుకున్నాడు? రెండు స్పెల్స్ ఒకే టీం కి వ్యతిరేకంగా వరుస రోజుల్లో మొదటి ఇన్నింగ్స్లో వచ్చాయి. అతన దేశం, వికెట్లు/ఇచ్చిన పరుగుల రేషియో మరియు వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p2.player_name,
  m.stage,
  m.match_winner / (m.result_margin + 0.0),
  CASE
    WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner
      THEN m.team2
    ELSE m.team1
  END AS opponents
FROM FielderDismissals fd
JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p2 ON d.bowler_id = p2.player_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch piv2 ON m.match_id = piv2.match_id
							AND p2.player_id = piv2.player_id
							AND piv2.team_name = m.match_winner
JOIN Players p1 ON d.striker_id = p1.player_id
WHERE d.ball_number < 5 AND d.extra_runs = 0 AND d.inning = 1;

question: T20I బౌలింగ్ ఇతిహాసలో ఏ స్పిన్నర్ ఒక ఇన్నింగ్స్లో 5 వికెట్లు తీసుకోకుండా అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ బంతులు విసిరాడు? అతన దేశం, వికెట్ల సంఖ్య మరియు ఎకానమీ రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH MatchWickets AS (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(runs_scored + wides + noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(mw.bowling_team) AS country, SUM(mw.match_wkts) AS wickets, (SUM(mw.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mw.match_balls), 0)) AS economy FROM MatchWickets mw JOIN Players p ON mw.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY mw.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mw.match_wkts) < 5 ORDER BY SUM(mw.match_balls) DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    P.player_name AS player_name,
    'India' AS country,
    SUM(DECASE(IIF(T1.wicket_type IN ('lbw', 'bowled', 'caught'), 1, 0)) / NULLIF(T1.ball_number, 0)) AS wickets,
    CAST(SUM(T1.extra_runs + T1.runs_scored) AS REAL) / SUM(T1.ball_number) AS economy
FROM 
    Deliveries T1
INNER JOIN 
    Matches T2 ON T2.match_id = T1.match_id
INNER JOIN 
    Players T3 ON T3.player_id = T1.bowler_id
INNER JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch T4 ON T4.player_id = T1.bowler_id AND T4.match_id = T1.match_id
INNER JOIN 
    Players P ON P.player_id = T4.player_id
WHERE 
    T3.player_name != T2.team1
    AND T3.player_name != T2.team2
    AND NOT (T1.wide_runs > 0 OR T2.extras wides AND T2.extras noballs)
    AND (T3.player_name IN ('Bhuvneshwar Kumar',  'Ravichandran Ashwin', 'Yuzvendra Chahal') OR  'Ravindra Jadeja')
    AND T1.inning = 1 
GROUP BY 
    P.player_name 
ORDER BY 
	wickets DESC;

question: T20I ਕਰੀਅਰ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿਹੜੇ ਸਪਿਨਰ ਨੇ ਕਦੇ ਪੰਜ ਵਿਕਟ ਹਾਲ ਨਾ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਸੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਉਸਦਾ ਦੇਸ਼, ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਇਕਾਨਮੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH MatchWickets AS (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(runs_scored + wides + noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(mw.bowling_team) AS country, SUM(mw.match_wkts) AS wickets, (SUM(mw.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mw.match_balls), 0)) AS economy FROM MatchWickets mw JOIN Players p ON mw.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY mw.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mw.match_wkts) < 5 ORDER BY SUM(mw.match_balls) DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name, 
       p1.player_name AS country, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.bowling_team = 'p' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.runs_scored = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN b.extra_runs + b.wides + b.noballs + b.byes + b.legbyes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS economy
FROM Deliveries b
JOIN Matches m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id AND pim.team_name = 'p'
JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN Players p1 ON p.player_name ILIKE 'India' OR p.player_name ILIKE 'Australia' OR p.player_name ILIKE 'Pakistan'
WHERE 
      b.extra_runs + b.wides + b.noballs + b.byes + b.legbyes = 0 AND 
      m.season != '' AND 
      b.wides = 0 AND 
      b.noballs = 0 AND 
      b.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE toss_winner = 'p' AND result_margin IS NOT NULL AND (result_type = 'win' OR result_type = 'loss') AND match_date LIKE '2001%' ) AND 
      b.bowler_id IN (SELECT p2.player_id FROM Deliveries pb 
       JOIN Matches m2 ON pb.match_id = m2.match_id
       JOIN PlayerInMatch pim2 ON m2.match_id = pim2.match_id AND pim2.team_name != 'p'
       JOIN Players p2 ON pim2.player_id = p2.player_id
       WHERE m2.season != '' AND pb.extra_runs + pb.wides + pb.noballs + pb.byes + pb.legbyes = 0
       GROUP BY p2.player_id
       HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN pb.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN pb.delivery_id ELSE NULL END) > 4)
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY wickets DESC;

question: ਕਿਸ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਨੇ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਦੋ ਦਿਨਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਵਿਕਟ ਹਾਲ ਲਏ? ਉਸਦਾ ਦੇਸ਼, ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ, ਅਤੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  p.country AS country,
  (COALESCE(D.sum_runs, 0) / COALESCE(D.num_wickets, 1)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio,
  LTRIM(SUBSTR(m.match_date, 5, 3)) || '-' || SUBSTR(m.match_date, 8, 3) AS opponents
FROM 
  ( 
    SELECT 
      player_id, 
      SUM(runs_scored) AS sum_runs, 
      COUNT(DISTINCT wicket_type) AS num_wickets 
    FROM 
      Deliveries 
    WHERE 
      wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
    GROUP BY 
      player_id 
    HAVING 
      COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) >= 2 
  ) AS D
JOIN 
  PlayerInMatch AS PIM ON PIM.player_id = D.player_id
JOIN 
  Matches AS M ON M.match_id = PIM.match_id AND M.season = PIM.team_name
JOIN 
  Players AS P ON P.player_id = D.player_id
JOIN 
  ( 
    SELECT 
      player_id, 
      MATCH(match_id) OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_id) AS consecutive_matches
    FROM 
      Deliveries 
  ) AS C ON C.player_id = D.player_id
WHERE 
  C.consecutive_matches = 2 
GROUP BY 
  D.player_id, p.player_name, m.match_date
ORDER BY 
  p.player_name;

question: In T20I career bowling history, which spinner has bowled the most balls despite never taking a five-wicket haul, name his country, wickets, economy?
gold_sql: WITH MatchWickets AS (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(runs_scored + wides + noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(mw.bowling_team) AS country, SUM(mw.match_wkts) AS wickets, (SUM(mw.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mw.match_balls), 0)) AS economy FROM MatchWickets mw JOIN Players p ON mw.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY mw.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mw.match_wkts) < 5 ORDER BY SUM(mw.match_balls) DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    P.player_name AS player_name,
    'no change' AS country,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN FIELDER_dismissal != 'bowled' AND FIELDER_dismissal != 'lbw'
        AND (D.wides = 0 OR D.noballs = 0) AND D.extra_runs = 0 
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) OVER (PARTITION BY i.player_id ORDER BY i.player_id) AS wickets
    ,SUM(CASE 
        WHEN FIELDER_dismissal != 'bowled' AND FIELDER_dismissal != 'lbw'
        AND (D.wides = 0 OR D.noballs = 0) AND D.extra_runs = 0 
        THEN D.ball_number 
        ELSE 0
    ) 
    OVER (PARTITION BY i.player_id ORDER BY i.player_id) / 
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN FIELDER_dismissal != 'bowled' AND FIELDER_dismissal != 'lbw'
        AND (D.wides = 0 OR D.noballs = 0) AND D.extra_runs = 0 
        THEN D.ball_number 
        ELSE 0
    ) 
    OVER (PARTITION BY i.player_id ORDER BY i.player_id) * 6 AS economy

FROM Players AS P
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT match_id, striker_id, bowler_id 
    FROM Deliveries 
    WHERE inning = 1 AND (delivery_id IN (
        SELECT delivery_id 
        FROM Deliveries 
        WHERE inning = 1 AND STRI Ker SRb WARE fielder_id IS NOT NULL 
        AND FIELDER_dismissal IS NOT NULL
        EXCEPT 
        SELECT FIELDER_dismissal_id 
        FROM FielderDismissals 
        WHERE FIELDER_dismissal IN ('bowled','lbw')
    ))
) AS i ON P.player_id IN (i.striker_id, i.bowler_id)
LEFT JOIN Deliveries AS D ON D.match_id = i.match_id 
                         AND for kd PLAYER-id 
                         AND ((D.striker_id = i.striker_id AND D.player_out_id = i.bowler_id) 
                              OR (D.striker_id = i.bowler_id AND D.player_out_id = i.striker_id))

GROUP BY P.player_id
HAVING SUM(CASE 
    WHEN FIELDER_dismissal != 'bowled' AND FIELDER_dismissal != 'lbw'
    AND (D.wides = 0 OR D.noballs = 0) AND D.extra_runs = 0 
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
) OVER (PARTITION BY i.player_id ORDER BY i.player_id) = 0
ORDER BY SUM(CASE 
    WHEN FIELDER_dismissal != 'bowled' AND FIELDER_dismissal != 'lbw'
    AND (D.wides = 0 OR D.noballs = 0) AND D.extra_runs = 0 
    THEN D.ball_number 
    ELSE 0
)

gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Bangladesh' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id) SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(bms.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bms.match_balls), 0)) AS economy, SUM(bms.match_wkts) AS wickets, SUM(CASE WHEN bms.match_wkts >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS three_wicket_hauls FROM BowlerMatchStats bms JOIN Players p ON bms.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY bms.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(bms.match_balls) >= 100 ORDER BY three_wicket_hauls DESC LIMIT 1;

question: New Zealand and India tied in T20Is on consecutive days. Give the dates and venues of the matches.
gold_sql: WITH NZ_IND_Ties AS (SELECT match_date, venue FROM Matches WHERE ((team1 = 'New Zealand' AND team2 = 'India') OR (team1 = 'India' AND team2 = 'New Zealand')) AND result_type = 'tie') SELECT t1.match_date AS date1, t1.venue AS venue1, t2.match_date AS date2, t2.venue AS venue2 FROM NZ_IND_Ties t1 JOIN NZ_IND_Ties t2 ON date(t2.match_date) = date(t1.match_date, '+2 day');

  m1.venue AS venue1,
  m2.match_date AS date2,
  m2.venue AS venue2

gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Bangladesh' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id) SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(bms.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bms.match_balls), 0)) AS economy, SUM(bms.match_wkts) AS wickets, SUM(CASE WHEN bms.match_wkts >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS three_wicket_hauls FROM BowlerMatchStats bms JOIN Players p ON bms.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY bms.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(bms.match_balls) >= 100 ORDER BY three_wicket_hauls DESC LIMIT 1;

question: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ ਆਖਰੀ ਗੇਂਦ 'ਤੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਟੀਚਾ ਚੇਜ਼ ਕੀਤਾ? ਉਸ ਟੀਮ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ, ਟੀਚਾ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ, ਜਿੱਤ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i2.batting_team AS team_name, (i1.total_runs + 1) AS target, i2.bowling_team AS opponents, m.result_margin, m.match_date FROM InningStats i1 JOIN InningStats i2 ON i1.match_id = i2.match_id AND i1.inning = 1 AND i2.inning = 2 JOIN Matches m ON i1.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner = i2.batting_team AND i2.legal_balls = 120 ORDER BY target DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql: SELECT T1.team_name, T2.target, T1.team2 AS opponents, T2.result_margin AS result_margin, T2.match_date AS match_date FROM PlayerInMatch T1 INNER JOIN Matches T2 ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id WHERE T1.team_name = ( SELECT T3.team_name FROM PlayerInMatch T3 INNER JOIN Deliveries T4 ON T3.match_id = T4.match_id WHERE T4.wides = 0 AND T4.noballs = 0 AND T4.ball_number = ( SELECT MAX(T5.ball_number) FROM Deliveries T5 WHERE T5.wides = 0 AND T5.noballs = 0 AND T5.inning = 2 GROUP BY T5.match_id, T5.bowler_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN T5.wicket_type IN ('lbw', 'bowled', 'caught') THEN 1 END) = 2 ) ) AND T3.team_name IN ( SELECT T6.team1, T6.team2 FROM Matches T6 WHERE T6.result_type = 'won' GROUP BY T6.team1, T6.team2 ) GROUP BY T3.match_id, T3.team_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN T4.wicket_type IN ('lbw', 'bowled', 'caught') THEN 1 END) = 2 ORDER BY SUM(T4.runs_scored) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS final_team

gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i2.batting_team AS team_name, (i1.total_runs + 1) AS target, i2.bowling_team AS opponents, m.result_margin, m.match_date FROM InningStats i1 JOIN InningStats i2 ON i1.match_id = i2.match_id AND i1.inning = 1 AND i2.inning = 2 JOIN Matches m ON i1.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner = i2.batting_team AND i2.legal_balls = 120 ORDER BY target DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which team achieved an average of 200 in T20I history in just 14.1 overs. Name their opposition and score
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opposition, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 85 AND (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) = 200;

    batting_team AS batting_team,
    opposition,
    SUM(runs_scored) + extra_runs AS score
FROM 
    Deliveries 
WHERE 
    ((over_number * 6 + ball_number) / 60) = 14.1 
    AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 
    AND batting_team != bowler_id 
    AND inning = 1

GROUP BY 
    batting_team, opposition;

question: T20I ఇతిహాసలో ఏ టీం కేవలం 14.1 ఓవర్లలో 200 ఆవెరేజ్ సంపాదించింది? వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం మరియు స్కోర్ రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opposition, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 85 AND (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) = 200;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    batting_team AS "batting team",
    team2 AS "opposition",
    SUM(runs_scored) AS score
FROM (
    SELECT 
        d.batting_team,
        m.team2,
        (d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6 * (d.over_number + (d.ball_number - 1) / 6) / 14.1 AS score
    FROM 
        Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE 
        inning = 1 
        AND m.season = 'T20I'
        AND wides = 0 
        AND noballs = 0 
        AND d.ball_number <= 91
        AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY 
        d.match_id
) t
GROUP BY 
    batting_team
HAVING 
    AVG(score) = 200
LIMIT 1;

question: Which team achieved the highest average per wicket in fewer than 9 overs in T20I history. Give the name of the team, average, overs, opposition, and date?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team AS team_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs, d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date AS date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.match_date HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 54 ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT T2.team_name, 
       ROUND(SUM(T1.ball_number * 6) / COUNT(T1.match_id)) AS average,
       SUM(T1.over_number) / COUNT(T1.match_id) AS overs,
       T4.team2 AS opposition, 
       T4.match_date AS date

JOIN PlayerInMatch T2 ON T2.match_id = T1.match_id AND T2.player_id = T1.striker_id
JOIN Matches T4 ON T1.match_id = T4.match_id

gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team AS team_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs, d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date AS date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.match_date HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 54 ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1;

    p.team_name AS team_name,
    AVG(r.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT D.wicket_type) AS average,
    D.over_number AS overs,
    M.opposition AS opposition,
    M.date AS date

question: Which Bangladeshi bowler has taken the most 3+ wicket hauls with 100+ balls in season 2026. Report his economy, wickets, and how many 3+ wicket hauls does he have
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Bangladesh' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id) SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(bms.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bms.match_balls), 0)) AS economy, SUM(bms.match_wkts) AS wickets, SUM(CASE WHEN bms.match_wkts >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS three_wicket_hauls FROM BowlerMatchStats bms JOIN Players p ON bms.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY bms.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(bms.match_balls) >= 100 ORDER BY three_wicket_hauls DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name, 
    SUM(d.extras_wicks) / SUM(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS economy, 
    COALESCE(T3.wickets, 0) AS wickets,
    COALESCE(T3.three_wicket_hauls, 0) AS three_wicket_hauls
FROM 
    Deliveries d 
INNER JOIN 
    Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id 
WHERE 
    d.season = '2026' 
    AND d.wides = 0 
    AND d.noballs = 0 
    AND p.team = 'Bangladesh' 
    AND exists ( SELECT 1 
                    FROM FielderDismissals f 
                    WHERE f.delivery_id = d.delivery_id 
                    AND f.fielder_id = p.player_id 
                    AND f.delivery_id != 3021 
                    AND ( SELECT CASE 
                                  WHEN 5100 + d3.ball_number > 100 THEN 1 
                                  ELSE 0 
                              END 
                          FROM Deliveries d1, Deliveries d2, Deliveries d3 
                          WHERE d1.bowling_team = 'Bangladesh' 
                          AND d1.striker_id = d3.striker_id 
                          AND d2.striker_id = d1.striker_id 
                          AND d3.ball_number = d2.ball_number + 1 
                          AND d1.ball_number + d2.ball_number + d3.ball_number > 100 
                          AND d2.gold > 100 
                          AND d3.gold > 100 
                      ) )
GROUP BY 
    player_name
ORDER BY 
    three_wicket_hauls DESC;

question: ఏ అసోసియేట్ దేశం 224 యొక్క ఆవెరేజ్ సంపాదించింది? (T20I ఇతిహాసలో లో 3వ అత్యాధికా) టీం, వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం, స్కోర్ మరియు తేదీ రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opposition, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.match_date HAVING (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) = 224;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    batting_team AS team,
    bowling_team AS opposition,
    SUM(runs_scored) AS score,
    MIN(match_date) AS match_date
FROM Deliveries
WHERE over_number > 15
GROUP BY batting_team, bowling_team
ORDER BY SUM(runs_scored) DESC
LIMIT 1

question: 224 का औसत हासिल करने वाली, जो टी20I इतिहास में तीसरा सबसे ऊंचा है, वह कौन-सी एसोसिएट राष्ट्र टीम थी — टीम, विपक्षी टीम, स्कोर और तारीख बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opposition, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.match_date HAVING (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) = 224;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  D.batting_team AS batting_team,
  D.opposition AS opposition,
  SUM(D.runs_scored) AS score,
  C.match_date AS match_date
FROM Deliveries D
JOIN Matches C ON D.match_id = C.match_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch P1 ON C.match_id = P1.match_id 
JOIN PlayerInMatch P2 ON C.match_id = P2.match_id AND P2.player_id = D.bowler_id
WHERE 
  C.city IN (
    SELECT team1 FROM Matches WHERE foreign_keys=0
  )
  AND (  P1.team_name = (
    SELECT team2 FROM Matches WHERE foreign_keys=0
    ORDER BY total_runs DESC  LIMIT 1
  ) OR P1.team_name = (
    SELECT team1 FROM Matches WHERE foreign_keys=0
    ORDER BY total_runs DESC  LIMIT 1
  ) )
  AND D.wides = 0 AND D.noballs = 0 
GROUP BY D.batting_team, D.opposition, C.match_date
HAVING AVG(D.runs_scored) = 224
ORDER BY SUM(D.runs_scored) DESC LIMIT 1

question: T20I ఇతిహాసలో ఏ టీం 9 ఓవర్లు కన్నా తక్కువలో ప్రతి వికెట్కు అన్నిటికన్నా పెద్ద ఆవెరేజ్ సంపాదించింది? టీం యొక్క పేరు, ఆవెరేజ్, ఓవర్లు, వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం మరియు తేదీ రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team AS team_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs, d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date AS date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.match_date HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 54 ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT T1.team_name, 
       T2.average,
       T2.overs,
       T1.opposition,
       T2.date
FROM Matches AS T1
JOIN (SELECT team1 AS team_name, 
             AVG(runs_scored) / ((over_number + 1) / 6) AS average, 
             (over_number + 1) / 6 AS overs, 
             match_date AS date 
      FROM Deliveries AS T2
      WHERE batting_team = team1
        AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
        AND match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'T20I')
        AND T2.inning = 1
      GROUP BY team1, match_date
      HAVING (over_number + 1) / 6 <= 9) AS T2
ON T1.team1 = T2.team_name
GROUP BY T1.team1, T1.season, T1.match_date
HAVING (over_number + 1) / 6 = 9
ORDER BY T2.average DESC

        WHEN match_id IN ( SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'T20I' ) 
        AND match_winner = batting_team 
        AND inning = 1 
    THEN 
        CASE
            WHEN result_type = 'win' 
            THEN team2 
            ELSE team1 
        END 
    END AS opposition,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ( 'run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field' ) 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS wickets_lost
FROM Deliveries
GROUP BY batting_team, inning
HAVING batting_team IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) * 6 / (delivery_id + 1)) DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, ROUND((SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)), 2) AS run_rate, d.bowling_team AS opposition, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_lost FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY run_rate DESC LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;

   SUM(CASE WHEN D2.wicket_type IN ('bowled', 'lbw', 'caught') 
                AND D3.delivery_id = F1.delivery_id THEN D3.runs_scored ELSE 0 END)) As wicket_to_runs_ratio,
  M1.opponents as opponents
FROM (
  SELECT distinct M1.match_date, M1.opponents
  FROM Matches M1
  JOIN Deliveries D1 ON M1.match_id = D1.match_id

question: टी20I इतिहास में 314 रन बनाकर 15.70 का रन रेट किस टीम ने हासिल किया? उसकी विपक्षी टीम, खोए गए विकेट और तारीख बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opposition, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_lost, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.match_date HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 314;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  T1.bowling_team AS batting_team, 
  T1.striker_id AS opposition, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.wicket_type NOT LIKE 'run out%' AND T3.wicket_type NOT LIKE 'retired hurt%' AND T3.wicket_type NOT LIKE 'obstructing the field%' THEN T3.delivery_id ELSE NULL END) AS wickets_lost, 
  T2.match_date 
FROM 
  Deliveries T1 
  INNER JOIN Matches T2 ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id 
  LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals T3 ON T1.delivery_id = T3.delivery_id 
WHERE 
  T1.batting_team = 'India' 
  AND T1.wides = 0 
  AND T1.noballs = 0 
  AND T1.runs_scored = 314 
  AND T2.season LIKE '20%'
  AND T2.stage LIKE 'T20I'
  AND T1.inning = 1 
GROUP BY 
  T1.bowling_team, 
  T1.striker_id, 
  T2.match_date 
HAVING 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.wicket_type NOT LIKE 'run out%' AND T3.wicket_type NOT LIKE 'retired hurt%' AND T3.wicket_type NOT LIKE 'obstructing the field%' THEN T3.delivery_id ELSE NULL END) * 1.0 / COUNT(T1.delivery_id) = 15.70

question: Which team holds the lowest ever innings total in T20I history, name their score, opposition, overs faced, and run rate?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, d.bowling_team AS opposition, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs_faced, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS run_rate FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY score ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT distinct 
    D.batting_team AS batting_team, 
    SUM(D.runs_scored) AS score, 
    Dbat.opponent AS opposition, 
    SUM(D.over_number) AS overs_faced, 
    (SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) / SUM( D.over_number + (CASE WHEN D.ball_number = 6 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END))) * 6 AS run_rate
FROM Deliveries D
JOIN (
    SELECT *, 
    (SELECT team2 
    FROM Matches 
    WHERE Matches.match_id = D.match_id AND inning = 2 ORDER BY extra_runs + runs_scored LIMIT 1) AS opponent 
    FROM Deliveries DNEW) AS Dbat ON D.match_id = Dbat.match_id
JOIN Deliveries D2 ON Dbat.match_id = D2.match_id
WHERE D.inning = 1 AND Dbat.inning = 2 AND D.wides = 0 AND D.noballs = 0 AND Dbat.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt' ,'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY Dbat.match_id
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opposition, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_lost, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.match_date HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 314;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    team2 AS batting_team,
    team1 AS opposition,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN matches.toss_winner = team1 THEN 
            SUM(CASE 
                WHEN deliveries.wicket_type IN ('lbw', 'caught', 'bowled', 'hit wicket', 'stumped', 'hit the ball then the wicketkeeper hit the stumps') 
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        WHEN matches.toss_winner = team2 THEN 
            SUM(CASE 
                WHEN deliveries.wicket_type IN ('lbw', 'caught', 'bowled', 'hit wicket', 'stumped', 'hit the ball then the wicketkeeper hit the stumps')

    AND inning = 1 AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND ball_number <= 20
GROUP BY 
    team1, matches.match_date
HAVING 
    AVG(deliveries.runs scored) = 15.7 AND team2 = (SELECT team2 FROM matches WHERE match_id = (  SELECT match_id FROM matches WHERE team1 = team2 AND result_margin = 314 LIMIT 1))

question: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੋ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਠੀਕ 10 ਰਨਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਆਊਟ ਹੋਈਆਂ ਹਨ — ਦੋਵੇਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਖੇਡੇ ਓਵਰ ਅਤੇ ਪਾਰੀ ਨੰਬਰ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opponents, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs_faced, d.inning AS innings_number FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 10;

    ( SELECT team2 FROM Matches WHERE match_id = D.match_id ) AS opponents, 
    SUM(D.over_number + D.ball_number) AS overs_faced, 
    D.inning AS innings_number

        OR COUNT(DISTINCT IF(D.non_striker_id = M.player_of_match_id AND ( D.wicket_type IN ('lbw', 'bowled', 'caught', 'stumped') OR D.wicket_type IS NULL ), D.non_striker_id, NULL)) = 1 
    )

question: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਦਾ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਪਾਰੀ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰ ਹੈ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਕੋਰ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ, ਖੇਡੇ ਓਵਰ ਅਤੇ ਰਨ ਰੇਟ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, d.bowling_team AS opposition, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs_faced, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS run_rate FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY score ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  bating_team AS batting_team,
  MIN(total_runs) AS score,
  opposition,
  MAX(overs) AS overs_faced,
  (total_runs / MAX(overs)) * 6 AS run_rate
FROM (
  SELECT 
    D.bowling_team AS opposition,
    M.team1 AS batting_team,
    SUM(CASE WHEN result_type = 'innings' THEN D.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) + SUM(D.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN result_type = 'innings' THEN D.ball_number WHEN D.ball_number = 6 THEN (1 + (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ball_number = 6 THEN ball_number ELSE 0 END) FROM Deliveries WHERE innings = 2 AND match_id = M.match_id)) WHEN D.ball_number = 5 THEN (1 + (SELECT (SELECT MAX(ball_number) FROM Deliveries WHERE innings = 1 AND match_id = M.match_id)) - 6) ELSE 0 END) AS overs,
    M.match_id
  FROM Matches M
  INNER JOIN Deliveries D
    ON M.match_id = D.match_id
    AND D.inning = 1
  WHERE M.season = 'T20I'
    AND D.wides = 0
    AND D.noballs = 0
    AND D.extra_runs = 0
    AND (D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field'))
  GROUP BY M.match_id
)
GROUP BY opposition, batting_team, total_runs, overs

  T.team2 AS opponents,
  COALESCE(SUM(D.over_number), 0) / COALESCE(SUM(D.ball_number), 1) AS overs_faced,
  D.inning AS innings_number
FROM 
  Deliveries D

question: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ 15.70 ਦੀ ਰਨ ਰੇਟ ਨਾਲ 314 ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ — ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ, ਗੁਆਈਆਂ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opposition, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_lost, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.match_date HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 314;

SELECT 
    b.batting_team AS batting_team,
    D.match_date AS match_date,
    SUM(DEXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries AS D1 WHERE D1.striker_id = P1(player_id) AND D1.match_id = D.match_id AND ((D1.wicket_type = 'run out') OR (D1.wicket_type = 'retired hurt') OR (D1.wicket_type = 'obstructing the field'))) ) AS wickets_lost,
    SUM(IIF(DEXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries AS D1 WHERE D1.striker_id = P1.player_id AND D1.match_id = D.match_id AND (D1.wides = 0 AND D1.noballs = 0)), 1, 0)) AS total_deliveries
FROM 
    Matches AS D
JOIN 
    Deliveries AS D1 ON D.match_id = D1.match_id
JOIN 
    ( SELECT i.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN i.with_batting_team = t1.team1 THEN r1.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(i.ball_number) AS run_rate
     FROM Deliveries AS i
     JOIN Matches AS M1 ON M1.match_id = i.match_id
     JOIN Matches AS M2 ON M2.match_id = i.match_id
     JOIN Players AS P1 ON P1.player_id = i.bowler_id
     JOIN Players AS P2 ON P2.player_id = i.striker_id
     JOIN Teams AS t1 ON t1.team_name = M1.team1
     WHERE M1.season = 'T20I' AND i.ball_number = 84 AND DEXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries AS ii WHERE ii.match_id = i.match_id AND (wide_or_noball) WHERE (ii.wides = 0 AND ii.noballs = 0))
     GROUP BY i.match_id having run_rate = 15.70
) AS m1 ON m1.match_id = D.match_id
JOIN Players AS P1 ON D.batting_team NOT IN (SELECT t1.team_name FROM Teams AS t1 LEFT JOIN Matches M2 ON m2.team2 = t1.team_name WHERE m2.match_id = D.match_id) THEN DEXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries AS D1 WHERE D1.striker_id = P1.player_id AND D1.match_id = D.match_id)
JOIN Matches AS M1 ON M1.match_id = D.match_id

HAVING SUM(IIF(DEXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries AS D1 WHERE D1.striker_id = P1.player_id AND D1.match_id = D.match_id AND (D1.wides = 0 AND D1.noballs = 0)), 1, 0)) = 314

question: Among all players with 14 POTM awards, which has the best award-to-match ratio — name all four players, their matches played, and calculate ratio for each
gold_sql: WITH POTM_Counts AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_count FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 14), Match_Counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, mc.matches_played, (pc.potm_count * 1.0 / mc.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM POTM_Counts pc JOIN Match_Counts mc ON pc.player_id = mc.player_id JOIN Players p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY award_to_match_ratio DESC LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  P.player_name, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT PMM.match_id) AS matches_played, 
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT PMM.match_id) AS REAL) / 14.0 AS award_to_match_ratio
FROM 
  Players P
  JOIN 
  PlayerInMatch PMM ON P.player_id = PMM.player_id
  JOIN 
  Matches M ON PMM.match_id = M.match_id
  JOIN 
  Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id
WHERE 
  D.player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
  P.player_name, D.player_of_match_id
HAVING 
  COUNT(DISTINCT D.delivery_id) = 14

question: T20I ఇతిహాసలో ఏ టీం దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ ఇన్నింగ్స్ స్కోర్ ఉన్నది? స్కోర్, వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం, ఓవర్ల సంఖ్య మరియు రన్ రేట్ రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, d.bowling_team AS opposition, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs_faced, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS run_rate FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY score ASC LIMIT 1;

            END) 
    + SUM(CASE

          JOIN Matches AS t2 ON t1.match_id = t2.match_id 
          WHERE LOWER(t2.season) LIKE 't20%' AND t2.stage = 't20i'

       (SELECT SUM(CASE 
                    WHEN t2.team1 = startup.team_name

            ) AS overs_for, 
 
            (SELECT SUM(CASE 
                         WHEN t2.team1 = startup.team_name

               FROM Matches AS t2 
               JOIN Deliveries AS t1 ON t2.match_id = t1.match_id 
               WHERE LOWER(t2.season) LIKE 't20%' AND t2.stage = 't20i'

                  ) 
             AND p.player_name NOT LIKE '%%' 
             AND LOWER(t1.season) LIKE 't20%' 
             AND (t1.team1 = p.player_name OR t2.team2 = p.player_name) 
          GROUP BY team1 
          ORDER BY overs_for + overs_against / NULLIF(overs_against, 0) DESC) AS ranked 
         WHERE RANK() OVER (ORDER BY overs_for + overs_against / NULLIF(overs_against, 0) DESC ) > 1) AS Unanswered 
         WHERE first_score IS NOT NULL
     ) AS st AS overs FROM
    (SELECT t1.batting_team, 
            SUM(CASE 
                WHEN t1.toss_winner = t1.batting_team AND t1.toss_decision = 'field'                THEN t1.result_margin 
                WHEN t1.toss_winner = t1.batting_team AND t1.toss_decision = 'bat' THEN 0 
                ELSE 0
                END) AS score, 
            case when t1.wide+ t2.wide = 0 and t2.no_ball = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 end AS is_legal 
       FROM Matches AS t1 
       JOIN Deliveries AS t2 ON t1.match_id = t2.match_id 
       JOIN PlayerInMatch AS t3 ON t3.match_id = t2.match_id 
       JOIN Players AS p on p.player_id = t3.player_id 
       WHERE SUMMARY.t1 LIKE 'year'
       AND (p.player_name LIKE '%%' OR p.player_name LIKE '%' OR p.player_name LIKE '%') limit 100 AND p.player_name = t2.striker_id 
       AND t1.match_winner = 'RESULT.$.ENUM[]){
         AND t1.toss_decision IN('field') AND t2extras = 0 GROUP BY t1.batting_team ORDER BY score DESC 
     ) AS startup 
     INNER JOIN Matches AS login 
     ON t1.match_id = t1.match_id AND startup.batting_team = t2.team1 INNER JOIN PlayerInMatch AS det 
     ON pinM.match_id = t2.match_id)
     WHERE ('%SMART%', scoring_team = 0) GROUP BY batting_team ORDER BY score;

question: Which player has won 8 POTM awards in the fewest matches in T20I history — name his country, span, and award ratio?
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, MAX(pim.team_name) AS country, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 8) SELECT p.player_name, ms.country, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_ratio FROM POTMStats ps JOIN MatchStats ms ON ps.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ms.matches_played ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name as player_name,
       t1.team1   as country,
       MIN(m.match_id) as span,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d2.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
       COUNT(DISTINCT d2.delivery_id) as award_ratio
FROM 
    Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id

    JOIN Deliveries d2 ON d1.match_id = d2.match_id AND d1.delivery_id < d2.delivery_id
WHERE m.season LIKE 'T20I%' AND pm.team_name = 'Team XXX' AND d2.player_out_id = m.player_of_match_id AND p.player_name = 'Player XXX'
GROUP BY p.player_name, t1.team1

question: टी20I इतिहास में सबसे कम मैचों में 8 POTM अवॉर्ड जीतने वाला खिलाड़ी कौन है — उसका देश, करियर स्पैन और अवॉर्ड अनुपात बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, MAX(pim.team_name) AS country, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 8) SELECT p.player_name, ms.country, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_ratio FROM POTMStats ps JOIN MatchStats ms ON ps.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ms.matches_played ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT P.player_name AS 'प्लेयर नाम',
       'भारत' AS 'देश',
       (SELECT MAX(match_date) - MIN(match_date) FROM Matches WHERE team1 = P.player_name OR team2 = P.player_name) AS 'करियर स्पैन',
       CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT M.match_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT PM.match_id) AS 'अवॉर्ड अनुपात'
FROM Players P
JOIN PlayerInMatch PM ON P.player_id = PM.player_id
JOIN Matches M ON PM.match_id = M.match_id
JOIN Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id
JOIN FielderDismissals F ON D.delivery_id = F.delivery_id
WHERE D.striker_id = P.player_id

  AND (D.wicket_type NOT LIKE 'run out' AND D.wicket_type NOT LIKE 'retired hurt' AND D.wicket_type NOT LIKE 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY P.player_id
ORDER BY COUNT(PM.match_id) = 8 DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT M.match_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which bowler reached 50 T20I wickets in the fewest matches. Report the name of his country, number of matches that took him to achieve it, the date he achieved it, and calculate exactly how many days it took him?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT p.player_name, m.country, m.match_number, m.match_date, CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_taken FROM Milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.player_id = p.player_id WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY m.match_number ASC LIMIT 1;

  a.days_taken

JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id

question: ఏ బౌలర్ అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ మ్యాచులలో 50 T20I వికెట్లు సంపాదించాడు? అతన దేశం, ఆడిన మ్యాచుల సంఖ్య, సంపాదించిన తేదీ మరియు సంపాదించడానికి రోజుల సంఖ్య రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT p.player_name, m.country, m.match_number, m.match_date, CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_taken FROM Milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.player_id = p.player_id WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY m.match_number ASC LIMIT 1;

FROM Players P

question: YM Nkanya took 50 wickets in the shortest calendar time. Calculate the exact days, name his country, matches, and achievement date?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'YM Nkanya' GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS exact_days, m.country, m.match_number AS matches, m.match_date AS achievement_date FROM Milestone m WHERE m.rn = 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM last_match_date - MIN(match_date)) AS exact_days,
       country_name,
       COUNT(*) AS matches,
       MIN(match_date) AS achievement_date
FROM ( 
    SELECT M.match_id, M.match_date, P.player_name, P.player_id, C.country_name
    FROM Matches M
    JOIN PlayerInMatch PIM ON M.match_id = PIM.match_id
    JOIN Players P ON PIM.player_id = P.player_id
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT team2
        FROM Matches
        UNION SELECT DISTINCT team1 FROM Matches
    ) T ON P.player_name = T.team2
    JOIN Countries C ON P.player_name = C.country_name
    WHERE P.player_name = 'YM Nkanya'
    AND M.match_date = (
        SELECT MAX(match_date)
        FROM Matches M
        JOIN PlayerInMatch PIM ON M.match_id = PIM.match_id
        JOIN Players P ON PIM.player_id = P.player_id
        WHERE P.player_name = 'YM Nkanya'
        GROUP BY M.match_id
        ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN team1 = P.player_name THEN team2 ELSE team1 END)) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
    AND M.match_date = (
        SELECT MAX(match_date)
        FROM Matches M
        JOIN PlayerInMatch PIM ON M.match_id = PIM.match_id
        JOIN Players P ON PIM.player_id = P.player_id
        JOIN Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id
        JOIN FielderDismissals FD ON D.delivery_id = FD.delivery_id
        WHERE P.player_name = 'YM Nkanya'
        AND D.wides = 0
        AND D.noballs = 0
        AND FD.fielder_id = P.player_id
        GROUP BY M.match_id
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
) AS T
GROUP BY country_name;

question: सबसे कम मैचों में 50 टी20I विकेट किस गेंदबाज़ ने पूरे किए? उसका देश, यह उपलब्धि हासिल करने में लगे मैच, उपलब्धि की तारीख, और ठीक-ठीक कितने दिन लगे, बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT p.player_name, m.country, m.match_number, m.match_date, CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_taken FROM Milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.player_id = p.player_id WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY m.match_number ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    country( SELECT team1 FROM Matches WHERE match_id = match AND team1 = country AND team2 = p.player_name OR team1 = p.player_name AND team2 = country ) AS country,
    -- सबसे कम मैचों
    COUNT(Matches.match_id) AS match_number,
    -- उपलब्धि की तारीख
    MAX(DeliveryDEMIRAY.match_date) AS match_date,
    -- उपलब्धि की तारीख में दिनों की संख्या
    ( 
        -- जाने वाले दिनों की संख्या
        SELECT MAX(T2.match_date) - MIN(T2.match_date) 
        FROM (
            -- डिलरम्योर्ट मैच के लिए मैच की तारीखों को अनुक्रमित करने के लिए रैंक
            SELECT match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date) AS row FROM 
            (
               SELECT player_of_match_id, MAX(match_date) AS match_date FROM Matches GROUP BY player_of_match_id UNION SELECT player_of_match_id, match_date AS match_date FROM Matches
            ) A
        ) T1
        JOIN (
            SELECT match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY match_date) AS row FROM (
                SELECT match_date FROM Matches
            ) B
        ) T2 ON T1.row = T2.row
    ) AS days_taken
FROM Matches
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = match_winner OR p.player_id = player_of_match_id

question: YM Nkanya ਨੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਸਮੇਂ ਵਿੱਚ 50 ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਲਈਆਂ। ਠੀਕ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਦਿਨ ਲੱਗੇ ਇਹ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ, ਉਸਦਾ ਦੇਸ਼, ਮੈਚ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤੀ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'YM Nkanya' GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS exact_days, m.country, m.match_number AS matches, m.match_date AS achievement_date FROM Milestone m WHERE m.rn = 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    0 AS exact_days,
    p.player_name AS country,
    SUM(CASE WHEN dm.decremented_days > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches,
    m.match_date AS achievement_date
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Players p ON d.bowler_id != p.player_id AND d.runner_out_id IS NULL
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pm1 ON p.player_id = pm1.player_id AND pm1.team_name = m.team1
JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch pm2 ON p.player_id = pm2.player_id AND pm2.team_name = m.team2
JOIN 
    HOME_EXCLUDED_CASE24084 dm ON d.delivery_id = dm.delivery_id AND dm.decision != 'stumped' 
GROUP BY 
    m.match_date, p.player_id 
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN dm.decremented_days > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 50

question: Name the top three Pakistani Bowlers who have fastest-to-50 wickets. Rank them by days taken fastest to slowest?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'Pakistan' GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT p.player_name, CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_taken FROM Milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.player_id = p.player_id WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY days_taken ASC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, (MAX(DATEDIFF(m.match_date, d.delivery_id)) - MIN(DATEDIFF(m.match_date, d.delivery_id))) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 AS days_taken
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id OR d.non_striker_id = p.player_id OR d.bowler_id = p.player_id OR d.player_out_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
WHERE p.player_name IN (
    SELECT d.bowler_id
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON d.match_id = pm.match_id
    WHERE pm.team_name = 'Pakistan' AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 GROUP BY d.bowler_id
)

JOIN (
  SELECT cast(DATEDIFF(d2.delivery_id, d1.delivery_id) - 1 as REAL) / 50 * 365 
  FROM Deliveries d1
  JOIN Deliveries d2 ON d1.striker_id = d2.striker_id AND d1.inning = d2.inning
  WHERE d1.match_id = d2.match_id AND d1.bowler_id != d2.bowler_id
  AND d1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
  AND d2.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
) as boom ON EXISTS (
  SELECT *
  FROM Deliveries d3
  WHERE d3.match_id = d.match_id AND d3.wicket_type = d2.wicket_type
)

WHERE p.player_name IN (
  SELECT d.bowler_id
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pm1 ON d.match_id = pm1.match_id
  WHERE pm1.team_name = 'Pakistan'
  AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 GROUP BY d.bowler_id
  ORDER BY SUM(IIF(d2.wicket_type IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field'), 1, 0)) / 50 * 365

)

ORDER BY (
  SELECT cast(DATEDIFF(d2.delivery_id, d1.delivery_id) - 1 as REAL) / 50 * 365 
  FROM Deliveries d1
  JOIN Deliveries d2 ON d1.striker_id = d2.striker_id AND d1.inning = d2.inning
  WHERE d1.match_id = d2.match_id AND d1.bowler_id != d2.bowler_id
  AND d1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
  AND d2.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
) DESC
