question: टी20I करियर में 5 शतक वाले सभी खिलाड़ियों में जीजे मैक्सवेल और आरजी शर्मा की तुलना कीजिए: खेली गई पारियां, औसत, SR, छक्के और डक बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH BatterMatch AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS is_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(bm.match_id) AS innings_played, (SUM(bm.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(dm.is_out), 0)) AS average, (SUM(bm.runs_scored) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bm.balls_faced), 0)) AS sr, SUM(bm.sixes) AS sixes, SUM(CASE WHEN bm.runs_scored = 0 AND dm.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterMatch bm JOIN Players p ON bm.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN Dismissals dm ON bm.player_id = dm.player_id AND bm.match_id = dm.match_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('GJ Maxwell', 'RG Sharma') GROUP BY bm.player_id, p.player_name;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_id = 'JG Maxwell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_id = 'RG Sharma' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS innings_played, 
       AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_id = 'JG Maxwell' THEN p.total_runs ELSE 0 END) + AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_id = 'RG Sharma' THEN p.total_runs ELSE 0 END) AS average, 
       AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_id = 'JG Maxwell' THEN p.fours + p.sixes ELSE 0 END) + AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_id = 'RG Sharma' THEN p.fours + p.sixes ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS sr, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_id = 'JG Maxwell' THEN p.sixes ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_id = 'RG Sharma' THEN p.sixes ELSE 0 END) AS sixes, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_id = 'JG Maxwell' THEN p.ducks ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_id = 'RG Sharma' THEN p.ducks ELSE 0 END) AS ducks
FROM (
  SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d batting_team = pm.team_name THEN d.delivery_id ELSE NULL END) AS total_runs,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN d batting_team = pm.team_name AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND d.runs_scored = d.ball_number THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS fours, 
         COUNT(CASE WHEN d batting_team = pm.team_name AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND d.ball_number - d.runs_scored = 2 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS sixes, 
         COUNT(CASE WHEN d batting_team = pm.team_name AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 AND d.ball_number - d.runs_scored >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS ducks
  FROM Players pm
  JOIN Deliveries d ON pm.player_id = d.bowler_id OR pm.player_id = d.striker_id OR pm.player_id = d.non_striker_id
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON pm.player_id = pim.player_id
  WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY pm.player_id
) p

question: ਕਿਸ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਨੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ T20I ਵਿੱਚ 50 ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਪੂਰੀਆਂ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ? ਉਸਦੇ ਦੇਸ਼ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ, ਇਹ ਹਾਸਲ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਲੱਗੇ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ, ਉਹ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਜਦੋਂ ਇਹ ਹਾਸਲ ਕੀਤਾ, ਅਤੇ ਠੀਕ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਦਿਨ ਲੱਗੇ ਇਹ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT p.player_name, m.country, m.match_number, m.match_date, CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_taken FROM Milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.player_id = p.player_id WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY m.match_number ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  'p.country' AS country,  -- This assumes a table 'p' containing country of players
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS match_number,
  MIN(m.match_date) AS match_date,
  (MAX(d.match_id) - MIN(d.match_id) + 1) AS days_taken
FROM 
  Players p
  JOIN Matches m ON m.team1 = p.player_name OR m.team2 = p.player_name
  JOIN Deliveries d ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
  JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
WHERE 
  m.season LIKE '%T20I%' AND d.runs_scored = d.extra_runs
GROUP BY 
  p.player_name
ORDER BY 
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) ASC
LIMIT 1

question: 5 T20I శతకాలు ఉన్న క్రీడాకారలో GJ Maxwell మరియు RG Sharma ని పోల్చండీ. ఆడిన ఇన్నింగ్ల సంఖ్య, ఆవెరేజ, స్ట్రైక్ రేట్, సిక్సుల సంఖ్య మరియు డక్కుల సంఖ్య రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH BatterMatch AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS is_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(bm.match_id) AS innings_played, (SUM(bm.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(dm.is_out), 0)) AS average, (SUM(bm.runs_scored) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bm.balls_faced), 0)) AS sr, SUM(bm.sixes) AS sixes, SUM(CASE WHEN bm.runs_scored = 0 AND dm.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterMatch bm JOIN Players p ON bm.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN Dismissals dm ON bm.player_id = dm.player_id AND bm.match_id = dm.match_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('GJ Maxwell', 'RG Sharma') GROUP BY bm.player_id, p.player_name;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN innings = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN innings = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS innings_played,
  (SUM(runs_scored) + SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inning = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average,
  (SUM(runs_scored) + SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inning = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)) / 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN over_number ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN inning = 2 THEN over_number ELSE 0 END) * 6) AS sr,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN delivery_id ELSE NULL END) AS sixes,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 0 AND innings = 1 THEN delivery_id ELSE NULL END) + 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 0 AND innings = 2 THEN delivery_id ELSE NULL END) AS ducks
FROM 
  Players p
  LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
  LEFT JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
  m.result_type = 'win'
  AND p.player_name IN ('GJ Maxwell', 'RG Sharma')
GROUP BY 
  p.player_name
HAVING 
  SUM(CASE WHEN inning = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN inning = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5

question: Abhishek Sharma has the highest career SR among all players with 2 hundreds . Give his strike rate, hundreds, average, and calculate how many balls he faces per hundred on average?
gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, CASE WHEN SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hundred FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), CareerStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(is_hundred) AS total_hundreds FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.player_out_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.player_out_id) SELECT p.player_name, (c.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(c.total_balls, 0)) AS strike_rate, c.total_hundreds AS hundreds, (c.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0)) AS average, (c.total_balls * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.total_hundreds, 0)) AS balls_per_hundred FROM CareerStats c JOIN Players p ON c.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON c.player_id = d.player_id;

SELECT 
  p.player_name, 
  SUM(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS REAL) / SUM(d.balls_number)) AS strike_rate,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = p.player_id THEN 1 END) AS hundreds,
  SUM(CAST(AVG(m.result_margin - d.extra_runs) AS REAL)) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS average,
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fid.howout, 'not out') NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND md.fielder_id = p.player_id THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fid.howout, 'not out') IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) 
FROM 
  Players p
  LEFT JOIN Matches m ON m.match_winner = p.player_id
  LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals fid ON fid.delivery_id = d.delivery_id AND fid.fielder_id = p.player_id
  INNER JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
  INNER JOIN Matches md ON md.match_id = pm.match_id
WHERE 
  p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma'
  AND d.extras = 0 
  AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
  p.player_id

question: 5 T20I ਕਰੀਅਰ ਸੈਂਕੜਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ, GJ Maxwell ਅਤੇ RG Sharma ਦੀ ਖੇਡੀਆਂ ਪਾਰੀਆਂ, ਔਸਤ, SR, ਛੱਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਡੱਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰ 'ਤੇ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਕਰੋ?
gold_sql: WITH BatterMatch AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS is_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(bm.match_id) AS innings_played, (SUM(bm.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(dm.is_out), 0)) AS average, (SUM(bm.runs_scored) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bm.balls_faced), 0)) AS sr, SUM(bm.sixes) AS sixes, SUM(CASE WHEN bm.runs_scored = 0 AND dm.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterMatch bm JOIN Players p ON bm.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN Dismissals dm ON bm.player_id = dm.player_id AND bm.match_id = dm.match_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('GJ Maxwell', 'RG Sharma') GROUP BY bm.player_id, p.player_name;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    P.player_name,
    COALESCE(T.innings_played, 0) AS innings_played,
    COALESCE(T.average, 0) AS average,
    COALESCE(T.sr, 0) AS sr,
    COALESCE(T.sixes, 0) AS sixes,
    COALESCE(T.ducks, 0) AS ducks
FROM (
    SELECT 
        P.player_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.match_winner = T2.player_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS innings_played,
        COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN T1.match_winner = T2.player_name THEN T1.runs_scored ELSE NULL END), 0) AS average,
        COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN T1.match_winner = T2.player_name THEN 100.0 * T1.runs_scored / T1.balls_faced ELSE NULL END), 0) AS sr,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.match_winner = T2.player_name AND T1.wicket_type!= 'run out' AND T1.wicket_type!= 'retired hurt' AND T1.wicket_type!= 'obstructing the field' AND T1.ball_number = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sixes,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.match_winner = T2.player_name AND T1.wicket_type!= 'run out' AND T1.wicket_type!= 'retired hurt' AND T1.wicket_type!= 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ducks
    FROM Matches T1
    JOIN PlayerInMatch T2 ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id AND T2.player_id = T2.player_id
    JOIN Deliveries T3 ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id AND T3.striker_id = T2.player_id
    WHERE T1.result_type = 'win' AND T2.team_name IN ('Australia', 'India') AND T2.player_id IN ('GJ Maxwell', 'RG Sharma')
    GROUP BY T2.player_id
) T
JOIN Players P ON P.player_id = T.player_name;

question: Two teams suffered 4 stumpings in a single innings in T20I history — name both teams, their scores and opposition
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, d.bowling_team AS opposition FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4;

gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, CASE WHEN SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hundred FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), CareerStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(is_hundred) AS total_hundreds FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.player_out_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.player_out_id) SELECT p.player_name, (c.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(c.total_balls, 0)) AS strike_rate, c.total_hundreds AS hundreds, (c.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0)) AS average, (c.total_balls * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.total_hundreds, 0)) AS balls_per_hundred FROM CareerStats c JOIN Players p ON c.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON c.player_id = d.player_id;

    SUM(CASE WHEN dr.runs_scored = 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hundreds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN dr.runs_scored > 0 THEN dr.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS average,

question: किस टीम ने 116 बनाते हुए 1 स्टंपिंग झेली, फिर भी जीत गई। विपक्षी टीम, स्थल और तारीख बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.venue, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner = d.batting_team GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.venue, m.match_date HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 116;
gold_answer: ["('Kuwait', 'Asian Institute of Technology Ground', '2019-02-27')", "('Germany', 'Desert Springs Cricket Ground, Almeria', '2021-09-11')", "('Sri Lanka', 'Zhejiang University of Technology Cricket Field', '2023-09-25')", "('Germany', 'Bayer Uerdingen Cricket Ground', '2024-07-28')"]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  T2.opposition AS opposition,
  T1.venue,
  T1.match_date AS match_date
  FROM Matches AS T1
  JOIN (
    SELECT 
      MAX(CASE WHEN wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN delivery_id END) AS stumping_delivery,
      match_id
      FROM Deliveries 
      WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
      GROUP BY match_id
  ) AS T3 ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
  JOIN (
    SELECT 
      MAX(delivery_id) AS max_stumping_delivery, match_id
      FROM FielderDismissals
      WHERE fielder_id IN (
        SELECT 
          striker_id
          FROM Deliveries
          WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND inning = 2 AND extras >= 116
      )
      GROUP BY match_id
  ) AS T4 ON T3.match_id = T4.match_id
  JOIN PlayerInMatch AS T5 ON T3.match_id = T5.match_id
  JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T5.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE (EXISTS (
    SELECT 
      1
      FROM Deliveries AS T6
      WHERE T6.match_id = T2.match_id
      AND T6.match_date = T2.match_date
      AND T6.batting_team = T2.team2
      AND T6.inning = 2
      AND T6.runs_scored + T6.extra_runs >= 116
       AND T6.inning = 2
      GROUP BY T6.inning
      HAVING SUM(T6.runs_scored + T6.extra_runs) = 116
   ) AND EXISTS (
     SELECT 
       1
       FROM FielderDismissals AS T7
       WHERE T7.match_id = T5.match_id
       AND T7.delivery_id = T4.max_stumping_delivery
       AND T7.fielder_id != T5.player_id
     )
  );

question: Which match had the highest number of no-balls ever recorded in a T20I? Name the teams, ground, date, and calculate what percentage of total extras in that match were no-balls alone.
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.venue AS ground, m.match_date AS date, SUM(d.noballs) AS total_noballs, (SUM(d.noballs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.extra_runs), 0)) AS noball_percentage FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY total_noballs DESC LIMIT 1;

question: 50 विकेट तक सबसे तेज़ पहुंचने वाले शीर्ष तीन पाकिस्तानी गेंदबाज़ों के नाम बताइए। उन्हें लगे दिनों के आधार पर सबसे तेज़ से सबसे धीमे क्रम में रैंक कीजिए।
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'Pakistan' GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT p.player_name, CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_taken FROM Milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.player_id = p.player_id WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY days_taken ASC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
SELECT P.player_name, D.days_taken AS days_taken
FROM (
    SELECT 
        D.bowler_id, 
        SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type != 'run out' AND wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND wicket_type != 'obstructing the field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, 
        (SUM(D.ball_number + D.extra_runs + (6 * (D.over_number + 1))) + SUM(D.extras_wanted)) AS deliveries,
        (SUM(D.ball_number + D.extra_runs + (6 * (D.over_number + 1))) + SUM(D.extras_wanted)) / 50 AS days_taken
    FROM Deliveries D
    JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
    WHERE M.team1 = 'Pakistan' OR M.team2 = 'Pakistan'
    GROUP BY D.bowler_id
) D
JOIN Players P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id
WHERE D.wickets = 50
ORDER BY D.days_taken;

question: ఆక్లాండ్‌లో జరిగిన న్యూజిలాండ్ vs వెస్ట్ ఇండీస్ (T20I #1108) మ్యాచ్ 31.2 ఓవర్లలో ముగిసింది, ఇందులో ఇరు జట్లు కలిసి 359 పరుగులు చేశాయి. మొత్తం జట్టు పరుగులలో నాన్-ఎక్స్‌ట్రాలు మరియు ఎక్స్‌ట్రాల ద్వారా వచ్చిన పరుగుల శాతాన్ని లెక్కించండి
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(runs_scored) AS non_extras, (SUM(extra_runs) * 100.0 / SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs)) AS extras_percentage FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = 1108;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN extras = 0 THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS non_extras,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN extras!= 0 THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / (SUM(CASE WHEN extras = 0 THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN extras!= 0 THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END)), 2) AS extras_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT SUM(runs_scored) FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE team1 = 'New Zealand' AND venue = 'Auckland' AND team2 = 'West Indies' AND match_date LIKE '2022-06-21%' AND result_type = 'Match not completed, target unachievable')) AS nz_score,
        (SELECT SUM(runs_scored) FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE team1 = 'New Zealand' AND venue = 'Auckland' AND team2 = 'West Indies' AND match_date LIKE '2022-06-21%' AND result_type = 'Match not completed, target unachievable')) AS wi_score
    FROM (
        SELECT '1108' AS match_id
    ) AS sub
) AS combined
WHERE nz_score + wi_score = 359;

question: प्रति ओवर सबसे अधिक नो-बॉल अनुपात वाले शीर्ष 3 मैचों की सूची दीजिए। दोनों टीमों के नाम और संबंधित अनुपात भी बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, (SUM(d.noballs) * 1.0 / (COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id || d.inning || d.over_number))) AS nb_per_over_ratio FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2 ORDER BY nb_per_over_ratio DESC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    M.team1 AS Team1,
    M.team2 AS Team2,
    SUM(D.noballs) / SUM(D.ball_number - (CASE WHEN D.wide = 0 AND D.noball = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS nb_per_over_ratio
FROM 
    Matches M
JOIN 
    Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id
WHERE 
    D.noballs > 0
GROUP BY 
    M.team1,
    M.team2
ORDER BY 
    nb_per_over_ratio DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: T20I చరిత్రలో అత్యధిక పరుగులు చేసిన మొదటి 5 మంది ఆటగాళ్లలో, ప్రతి ఒక్కరి స్ట్రైక్ రేట్, ప్రతి ఇన్నింగ్స్‌కు సగటు పరుగులు తెలిపి, బ్యాటింగ్ సగటు ఆధారంగా వారికి ర్యాంకులు ఇవ్వండి.
gold_sql: WITH BatterStats AS (SELECT d.striker_id, p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings_played FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name), Top5Batters AS (SELECT * FROM BatterStats ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT t.player_name, (t.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.balls_faced, 0)) AS strike_rate, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.innings_played, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_innings, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0)) AS batting_average FROM Top5Batters t LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON t.striker_id = d.player_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    (SUM(r.runs_scored) / SUM(d.ball_number)) AS strike_rate,
    SUM(r.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT d.inning) AS avg_runs_per_innings,
    SUM(r.runs_scored) / COUNT(p.player_id) AS batting_average
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Players p ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    m.season = 'T20I' AND 
    d.extra_runs = 0 AND 
    d.wides = 0 AND 
    d.noballs = 0 AND 
    d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id
ORDER BY 
    batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: T20I ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਮੈਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੁਣ ਤੱਕ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ No Ball ਹੋਏ? ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਮੈਦਾਨ, ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ ਅਤੇ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ ਕਿ ਉਸ ਮੈਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੁੱਲ ਵਾਧੂ ਰਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਨੋ ਬਾਲ ਸਨ?
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.venue AS ground, m.match_date AS date, SUM(d.noballs) AS total_noballs, (SUM(d.noballs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.extra_runs), 0)) AS noball_percentage FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY total_noballs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  team2 AS team1, 
  team1, 
  venue AS ground, 
  match_date AS date, 
  COALESCE(total_noballs, 0) AS total_noballs, 
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(noballs) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(noballs2) * 100) / (SUM(noballs) + SUM(noballs2)) 
  END AS noball_percentage
FROM (
  SELECT 
    M.team1, 
    M.team2, 
    M.venue, 
    M.match_date, 
    SUM(D.noballs) AS noballs, 
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN D.match_id = M.match_id AND D.batting_team = M.team1 THEN D.noballs 
      ELSE 0 
    END) AS noballs1, 
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN D.match_id = M.match_id AND D.batting_team = M.team2 THEN D.noballs 
      ELSE 0 
    END) AS noballs2
  FROM Matches M 
  JOIN Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id 
  WHERE M.season = 'T20I' 
  AND M.result_type != 'no result'
  AND D.wides = 0 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    M.team2 AS team1, 
    M.team1, 
    M.venue, 
    M.match_date, 
    SUM(D.noballs) AS noballs, 
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN D.match_id = M.match_id AND D.batting_team = M.team1 THEN D.noballs 
      ELSE 0 
    END) AS noballs1, 
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN D.match_id = M.match_id AND D.batting_team = M.team2 THEN D.noballs 
      ELSE 0 
    END) AS noballs2
  FROM Matches M 
  JOIN Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id 
  WHERE M.season = 'T20I' 
  AND M.result_type != 'no result'
  AND D.wides = 0 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
) AS sub
GROUP BY team1, team2, ground, date
ORDER BY total_noballs DESC LIMIT 1

question: Babar Azam leads all T20I run-scorers with 4596 runs. Give his runs per match ratio and what percentage of his runs came in boundaries
gold_sql: SELECT (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Players p2 ON pim.player_id = p2.player_id WHERE p2.player_name = 'Babar Azam')) AS runs_per_match_ratio, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored IN (4, 6) THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(d.runs_scored)) AS boundary_percentage FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Babar Azam';
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.striker_id = 'Babar Azam' THEN T1.runs_scored END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.match_id) AS runs_per_match_ratio,
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.striker_id = 'Babar Azam' WHEN T1.balls = 0 THEN T1.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
   * 100) / (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.striker_id = 'Babar Azam' THEN T1.runs_scored END) AS REAL)) AS boundary_percentage
FROM Deliveries T1
JOIN (
  SELECT delivery_id, inning 
  FROM Deliveries 
) AS T2 ON T1.delivery_id  =  T2.delivery_id
JOIN (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Players
  where player_id = 'Babar Azam'
) AS T3 ON 1=1
WHERE T1.extra_runs = 0
AND T1.wides = 0
AND T1.noballs = 0
AND T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field');

question: बाबर आज़म 4596 रनों के साथ सभी टी20I रन-स्कोररों में शीर्ष पर हैं। उनका रन-प्रति-मैच अनुपात और उनके कितने प्रतिशत रन बाउंड्री से आए, बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Players p2 ON pim.player_id = p2.player_id WHERE p2.player_name = 'Babar Azam')) AS runs_per_match_ratio, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored IN (4, 6) THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(d.runs_scored)) AS boundary_percentage FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Babar Azam';
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(runs_scored) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS runs_per_match_ratio,
    SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored - (extra_runs - (wides + noballs + byes + legbyes)) = runs_scored THEN extra_runs ELSE 0 END) / SUM(runs_scored) * 100 AS boundary_percentage
FROM 
    Players 
WHERE 
    player_id = 4596

question: ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਓਵਰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ No Ball ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਵਾਲੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ 3 T20I ਮੈਚਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਬਣਾਓ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, (SUM(d.noballs) * 1.0 / (COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id || d.inning || d.over_number))) AS nb_per_over_ratio FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2 ORDER BY nb_per_over_ratio DESC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    T1.team1 AS t1,
    T1.team2 AS t2,
    SUM(T3.noballs) / SUM(T3.over_number) AS nb_per_over_ratio
FROM 
    Matches AS T1
    INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T2 ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
    INNER JOIN ( SELECT 
                match_id,
                over_number,
                noballs,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY over_number) AS row_num
                 FROM 
                Deliveries
                 WHERE 
                wides = 0 AND noballs > 0 ) AS T3 ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE 
    T2.over_number = T3.over_number AND 
    T1.stage = 'T20' AND 
    T1.toss_winner IN (T1.team1, T1.team2) 
ORDER BY 
    nb_per_over_ratio DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ 5 ਰਨ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਲਈ, ਹਰੇਕ ਦੀ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਅਤੇ ਔਸਤ ਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਪਾਰੀ ਦੱਸੋ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਔਸਤ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਦਰਜਾਬੰਦੀ ਕਰੋ?
gold_sql: WITH BatterStats AS (SELECT d.striker_id, p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings_played FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name), Top5Batters AS (SELECT * FROM BatterStats ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT t.player_name, (t.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.balls_faced, 0)) AS strike_rate, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.innings_played, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_innings, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0)) AS batting_average FROM Top5Batters t LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON t.striker_id = d.player_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    CAST(SUM(Deliveries.runs_scored + Deliveries.extra_runs) AS REAL) / SUM(Deliveries.ball_number) AS strike_rate,
    CAST(SUM(Deliveries.runs_scored + Deliveries.extra_runs) AS REAL) / SUM(Deliveries.inning) AS avg_runs_per_innings,
    CAST(SUM(Deliveries.runs_scored + Deliveries.extra_runs) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT Deliveries.delivery_id) AS batting_average
FROM Deliveries 
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = Deliveries.striker_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON pm.match_id = Deliveries.match_id AND pm.player_id = Deliveries.striker_id
WHERE Deliveries.wides = 0 AND Deliveries.noballs = 0 AND Deliveries.match_id IN (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage = 'T20I'
)
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 players by catches per innings ratio also give the respective ratios.
gold_sql: WITH Catches AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY fd.fielder_id), InningsPlayed AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS total_innings FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, (c.total_catches * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.total_innings, 0)) AS catches_per_innings_ratio FROM Catches c JOIN InningsPlayed i ON c.fielder_id = i.player_id JOIN Players p ON c.fielder_id = p.player_id ORDER BY catches_per_innings_ratio DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, SUM(f.fielder_id IS NOT NULL) / D1.inning AS catches_per_innings_ratio
FROM Players p
LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON p.player_id = fd.fielder_id
JOIN Deliveries D1 ON fd.delivery_id = D1.delivery_id
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY catches_per_innings_ratio DESC
LIMIT 5

gold_sql: WITH BatterStats AS (SELECT d.striker_id, p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings_played FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name), Top5Batters AS (SELECT * FROM BatterStats ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT t.player_name, (t.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.balls_faced, 0)) AS strike_rate, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.innings_played, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_innings, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0)) AS batting_average FROM Top5Batters t LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON t.striker_id = d.player_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC;

generated_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.deliveries_type = 'dismissal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS catches, p.player_id FROM Players p LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.fielder_id LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id AND fd.fielder_id = d.fielder_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries dm ON d.delivery_id = dm.delivery_id + 1 AND dm.inning = d.inning INNER JOIN Deliveries t1 ON fd.delivery_id = t1.delivery_id AND t1.ball_number = 0 AND t1.wide_runs = 0 AND t1.noball_runs = 0 AND t1.extra_runs = 0 INNER JOIN Deliveries t2 ON fd.delivery_id = t2.delivery_id AND t2.ball_number = 1 AND t2.wide_runs = 0 AND t2.noball_runs = 0 AND t2.extra_runs = 0 INNER JOIN Matches m ON t1.match_id = m.match_id WHERE fd.wicket_type LIKE 'catch%' AND t1.wicket_type NOT IN ( 'Run Out', 'Retired Hurt', 'Obstructing the Field' ) AND t2.wicket_type NOT IN ( 'Run Out', 'Retired Hurt', 'Obstructing the Field' ) GROUP BY p.player_id ORDER BY catches / (SELECT count(*) - 6 * (CASE WHEN count(*) > 6 THEN count(*) - 6 ELSE 0 END) FROM Deliveries GROUP BY inning, match_id) DESC LIMIT 5

question: निकोलस पूरन टी20I 2026 सीज़न में एक ओवर में सबसे ज़्यादा रन बनाने के रिकॉर्ड में आते हैं। दोनों उदाहरण पूरे विवरण के साथ बताइए: रन, गेंदबाज़, मैच, स्थल और तारीख।
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, pb.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS match, m.venue, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players ps ON d.striker_id = ps.player_id JOIN Players pb ON d.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE ps.player_name = 'N Pooran' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, pb.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 2;

question: టీ20 అంతర్జాతీయ మ్యాచ్‌లలో 2026 సీజన్ లో ఒక ఓవర్‌లో అత్యధిక పరుగులు చేసిన రికార్డులలో నికోలస్ పూరన్ కనిపిస్తాడు. ఆ రెండు సందర్భాలను పరుగులు, బౌలర్, మ్యాచ్, వేదిక మరియు తేదీతో సహా పూర్తి వివరాలతో పేర్కొనండి.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, pb.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS match, m.venue, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players ps ON d.striker_id = ps.player_id JOIN Players pb ON d.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE ps.player_name = 'N Pooran' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, pb.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 2;
gold_answer: [['Dipendra Singh Airee', 36, 'Kamran Khan', 'Nepal v Qatar', 'Al Amerat'], ['Dipendra Singh Airee', 32, 'Mungun Altankhuyag', 'Nepal v Mongolia', 'Hangzhou']]
generated_sql:
SELECT d.runs_scored AS runs, 
       p.player_name AS bowler, 
       m.match_id AS match, 
       m.venue AS venue, 
       m.match_date AS match_date
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
JOIN ( SELECT over_number, MAX(runs_scored) AS max_runs
       FROM Deliveries 
       WHERE season = '2026' 
       GROUP BY over_number
     ) r ON d.over_number = r.over_number AND d.runs_scored = r.max_runs
WHERE m.stage = 'International T20'

AND d.wides = 0
AND d.noballs = 0
AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')

question: టీ20 అంతర్జాతీయ చరిత్రలో ఒకే ఓవర్‌లో అత్యధిక పరుగులు ఎవరు సాధించారు, మరియు ఎన్ని పరుగులు చేశారు? ఆ బౌలర్ పేరు మరియు మ్యాచ్ పేరును కూడా తెలపండి.
gold_sql: SELECT p_striker.player_name AS batter, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, p_bowler.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 || ' on ' || m.match_date AS match FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p_striker ON d.striker_id = p_striker.player_id JOIN Players p_bowler ON d.bowler_id = p_bowler.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.striker_id, d.bowler_id, p_striker.player_name, p_bowler.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.match_date ORDER BY runs_scored DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    P1.player_name AS batter,
    D.runs_scored,
    P2.player_name AS bowler,
    M.season AS match
FROM Deliveries D
JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
JOIN Players P1 ON D.striker_id = P1.player_id
JOIN Players P2 ON D.bowler_id = P2.player_id

question: T20I ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕੋ ਓਵਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਰਿਕਾਰਡਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਮੌਕਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਸੇ ਓਵਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਕਟ ਵੀ ਲਈ ਗਈ? ਖਿਡਾਰੀ, ਰਨ, ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼, ਮੈਚ, ਮੈਦਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name AS player, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs, p2.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS match, m.venue, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON d.bowler_id = p2.player_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.striker_id, d.bowler_id, p.player_name, p2.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: ['(\'R Powell\', 30, \'SM Curran\', \'West Indies vs England\', "National Cricket Stadium, St George\'s, Grenada", \'2023-12-14\')', "('AR Ramjani', 28, 'T Tshose', 'Uganda vs Botswana', 'Gahanga International Cricket Stadium, Rwanda', '2024-12-04')", "('Aamer Jamal', 26, 'A Shukla', 'Pakistan vs Hong Kong', 'Zhejiang University of Technology Cricket Field', '2023-10-03')", "('CH Gayle', 25, 'DL Vettori', 'New Zealand vs West Indies', 'Eden Park, Auckland', '2008-12-26')", "('NM Odhiambo', 25, 'Waseem Yaqoob', 'Kenya vs Lesotho', 'Integrated Polytechnic Regional Centre', '2022-11-21')"]

SELECT 
    P1.player_name AS player,
    D1.runs_scored AS runs,
    P2.player_name AS bowler,
    M.match_id AS match,
    M.venue AS venue,
    M.match_date AS match_date
FROM 
    Deliveries D1
JOIN 
    Deliveries D2 ON D1.match_id = D2.match_id AND D1.over_number = D2.over_number AND D1.ball_number != D2.ball_number
JOIN 
    Matches M ON D1.match_id = M.match_id
JOIN 
    Players P1 ON D1.striker_id = P1.player_id
JOIN 
    Players P2 ON D1.bowler_id = P2.player_id
WHERE 
    D1.balls_bowler_wkts NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    AND D1.legal_delivery = 1 OR D2.legal_delivery = 1;

question: Nicholas Pooran appears in the most runs off one over records in T20Is 2026 season. List both instances with full details including runs, bowler, match, venue, and date.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, pb.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS match, m.venue, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players ps ON d.striker_id = ps.player_id JOIN Players pb ON d.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE ps.player_name = 'N Pooran' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, pb.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 2;
gold_answer: [['Dipendra Singh Airee', 36, 'Kamran Khan', 'Nepal v Qatar', 'Al Amerat'], ['Dipendra Singh Airee', 32, 'Mungun Altankhuyag', 'Nepal v Mongolia', 'Hangzhou']]
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    r.runs AS runs,
    b.player_name AS bowler,
    m.match_id AS match || '-' || m.match_number AS match,
    m.venue AS venue,
    m.match_date AS match_date
FROM (
    SELECT
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id ORDER BY d.runs DESC) AS rn,
        d.match_id,
        d.runs,
        d.striker_id,
        d.bowler_id
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE 
        d.delivery_id IN (
            SELECT d1.delivery_id
            FROM Deliveries d1
            JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON d1.match_id = pm.match_id
            JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = pm.match_id
            JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = d1.striker_id
            WHERE 
                m.season = 'T20 Int. - 2026'
                AND m.toss_decision = 'bat'
                AND p.player_name = 'Nicholas Pooran'
        ) 
        AND d.inning = 1
        AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
) r
JOIN Players b ON r.bowler_id = b.player_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON r.match_id = d.match_id AND r.runs = d.runs AND r.striker_id = d.striker_id
JOIN Matches m ON r.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE r.rn <= 1;

question: What is the shortest completed innings in T20I history by balls? Give the team, score, balls, run rate, opposition.
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team AS team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS run_rate, d.bowling_team AS opposition FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.result_type NOT IN ('no result', 'abandoned') GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY balls ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT
  P1.team_name AS team,
  SUM(D.runs_scored) + SUM(D.extra_runs) AS score,
  SUM(D.ball_number) AS balls,
  (SUM(D.runs_scored) + SUM(D.extra_runs)) / SUM(D.ball_number) * 6 AS "run_rate",
  P2.team_name AS opposition
FROM
  Deliveries D
  LEFT JOIN PlayerInMatch P1 ON D.batting_team = P1.team_name AND D.match_id = P1.match_id AND D.inning = 1 AND P1.player_id = D.striker_id
  LEFT JOIN PlayerInMatch P2 ON D.batting_team = P2.team_name AND D.match_id = P2.match_id AND D.inning = 1 AND P2.player_id = D.non_striker_id
WHERE
  D.wide_runs = 0 AND D.noball_runs = 0 AND D.runs_scored IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  P1.team_name, P2.team_name
HAVING
  SUM(D.ball_number) = (
    SELECT
      MIN(SUM(ball_number))
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          D.match_id, D.inning, D.ball_number
        FROM
            Deliveries D
            JOIN PlayerInMatch P1 ON D.batting_team = P1.team_name AND D.match_id = P1.match_id AND D.inning = 1 AND P1.player_id = D.striker_id
            JOIN PlayerInMatch P2 ON D.batting_team = P2.team_name AND D.match_id = P2.match_id AND D.inning = 1 AND P2.player_id = D.non_striker_id
        GROUP BY
          D.match_id, D.inning
        HAVING
          COUNT(DISTINCT D.wide_runs) = 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT D.noball_runs) = 0
      ) AS subquery
  ) AND P1.team_name NOT IN (
    SELECT
      team_name
    FROM
      PlayerInMatch
    JOIN Deliveries D ON PlayerInMatch.match_id = D.match_id AND PlayerInMatch.player_id = D.bowler_id
    JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
    GROUP BY
      PlayerInMatch.team_name
    HAVING
      COUNT(DISTINCT D.match_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'T20I')
  );

question: Among the top 5 run-scorers in T20I history, give the strike rate , the average runs per innings for each, and rank them by batting average.
gold_sql: WITH BatterStats AS (SELECT d.striker_id, p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings_played FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name), Top5Batters AS (SELECT * FROM BatterStats ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT t.player_name, (t.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.balls_faced, 0)) AS strike_rate, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.innings_played, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_innings, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0)) AS batting_average FROM Top5Batters t LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON t.striker_id = d.player_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    (CAST(SUM(r.runs_scored) AS REAL) * 100) / SUM(d.ball_number) AS strike_rate,
    (CAST(SUM(r.runs_scored) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id)) AS avg_runs_per_innings,
    CAST(SUM(r.runs_scored) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS batting_average
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN 
    Deliveries r ON d.ball_number = 1 AND r.delivery_id < d.delivery_id AND r.match_id = d.match_id
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id
ORDER BY 
    batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: T20Iలలో ఒకే ఓవర్‌లో అత్యధిక పరుగులు చేసిన రికార్డులలో, అదే ఓవర్‌లో వికెట్ కూడా పడిన సందర్భాలు ఏవి? ఆటగాడు, పరుగులు, బౌలర్, మ్యాచ్, వేదిక మరియు తేదీని తెలపండి.
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name AS player, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs, p2.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS match, m.venue, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON d.bowler_id = p2.player_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.striker_id, d.bowler_id, p.player_name, p2.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 5;

    p.player_name AS player,
    d.runs_scored AS runs,
    p1.player_name AS bowler,
    d.match_id AS match,

    m.match_date AS match_date
FROM 
    Deliveries d

question: టీ20 అంతర్జాతీయ చరిత్రలో బంతుల పరంగా అత్యంత తక్కువ సమయంలో పూర్తయిన ఇన్నింగ్స్ ఏది? ఆ జట్టు, స్కోరు, బంతులు, రన్ రేట్, ప్రత్యర్థిని తెలపండి
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team AS team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS run_rate, d.bowling_team AS opposition FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.result_type NOT IN ('no result', 'abandoned') GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY balls ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  d.batting_team AS team,
  d.runs_scored AS score,
  SUM(d.ball_number) - (SUM(IIF(d.delivery_id IS NULL, 6, d.ball_number)) - 6) AS balls,
  (SUM(d.runs_scored) + SUM(d.extra_runs)) / SUM(d.ball_number) * 6 AS run_rate,
  d.bowling_team AS opposition
FROM 
  Deliveries d
WHERE 
  d.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE result_type = 'win' AND stage = 'International Twenty20')
  AND d.inning = 1
  AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
  d.batting_team, d.bowling_team
ORDER BY 
  balls;

gold_sql: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs, it.team_total, ROUND((ps.player_runs * 100.0 / it.team_total), 2) AS percentage_of_team_total FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC LIMIT 5;

gold_sql: WITH PlayerAllInnings AS (SELECT p.player_name, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, d.batting_team AS team_name, d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.venue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.match_date) AS inning_seq FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name = 'S Dube' GROUP BY p.player_name, d.match_id, m.match_date, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.venue), FiftyInnings AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY match_date) AS fifty_seq FROM PlayerAllInnings WHERE runs >= 50), StreakGroups AS (SELECT *, (inning_seq - fifty_seq) AS streak_id FROM FiftyInnings), ValidStreaks AS (SELECT streak_id FROM StreakGroups GROUP BY streak_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT sg.player_name, sg.runs, sg.team_name, sg.opposition, sg.venue FROM StreakGroups sg JOIN ValidStreaks vs ON sg.streak_id = vs.streak_id ORDER BY sg.match_date LIMIT 2;

question: ਹਰੇਕ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਜਿਸਨੇ ਪੂਰੀ T20I ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾਟ ਆਊਟ ਰਿਹਾ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਕੁੱਲ ਟੀਮ ਸਕੋਰ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਵਜੋਂ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ?
gold_sql: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs, it.team_total, ROUND((ps.player_runs * 100.0 / it.team_total), 2) AS percentage_of_team_total FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC LIMIT 5;

                                   FROM Deliveries d 
                                   WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id

WHERE m.match_id != 0

                        FROM Deliveries dr

gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team AS team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS run_rate, d.bowling_team AS opposition FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.result_type NOT IN ('no result', 'abandoned') GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY balls ASC LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) >= 100), BattingStats AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), DismissalStats AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(delivery_id) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT p.player_name, ms.matches_played AS matches, COALESCE(bs.total_runs, 0) AS runs, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(bs.total_runs, 0) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ds.dismissals, 0), 0), 2) AS average, ms.span FROM MatchStats ms JOIN Players p ON ms.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN BattingStats bs ON ms.player_id = bs.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissalStats ds ON ms.player_id = ds.player_id ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1;

  SUM(DD.matches) AS matches,
  SUM(DD.runs_scored) AS runs,

      D1.player_id,

              D3.striker_id = D1.player_id
          )

          D3.match_id = D1.match_id AND

gold_sql: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs AS runs, it.team_total, it.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY ps.player_runs DESC LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs AS runs, it.team_total, it.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY ps.player_runs DESC LIMIT 1;

question: ਕਿਸ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਨੇ 2 ਪਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਾਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਟੀਮ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਕੋਰ ਅਤੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਟੇਬਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਾਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਿੰਗਲ ਪਾਰੀ ਸਕੋਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੀ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਸੀ?
gold_sql: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayersWith2Innings AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2), TopPlayer AS (SELECT p.player_name, pw.total_runs FROM PlayersWith2Innings pw JOIN Players p ON pw.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY pw.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1), HighestSingleLossingInnings AS (SELECT MAX(innings_runs) AS max_single_innings FROM LosingSideInnings) SELECT tp.player_name, tp.total_runs AS two_innings_losing_total, hs.max_single_innings AS highest_single_innings_losing, (tp.total_runs - hs.max_single_innings) AS difference FROM TopPlayer tp CROSS JOIN HighestSingleLossingInnings hs;

SELECT p.player_name AS player_name, 
       SUM(d.runs_scored) AS two_innings_losing_total, 
       ( SELECT MAX(runs_scored) 
         FROM Deliveries d
         WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id 
         AND d.inning = 1 
         AND d.bowling_team = m.team2 
         AND m.match_winner = 'losing' 
       ) - ( SELECT MAX(runs_scored) 
             FROM Deliveries d
             WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id 
             AND d.inning = 1 
             AND d.bowling_team = m.team2 
             AND m.match_winner = 'losing' 
             AND d.ball_number = 1 
          ) AS highest_single_innings_losing,
       ( SELECT MAX(runs_scored) 
         FROM Deliveries d
         WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id 
         AND d.inning = 1 
         AND d.bowling_team = m.team2 
         AND m.match_winner = 'losing' 
       ) - ( SELECT MAX(runs_scored) 
             FROM Deliveries d
             WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id 
             AND d.inning = 1 
             AND d.bowling_team = m.team2 
             AND m.match_winner = 'losing' 
             AND d.ball_number = 1 
          ) AS difference
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE d.inning = 1 AND d.inning = 2
GROUP BY p.player_name

question: In T20Is, which team posted the highest score despite having 4 or more batsmen run out in a single innings and still lost the match? Return the team, score, opposition.
gold_sql: WITH InningScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type = 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_outs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition FROM InningScores i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.run_outs >= 4 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT team, SUM(r.runs_scored) AS score, team2 AS opposition 
FROM Deliveries AS r 
JOIN Matches AS m ON r.match_id = m.match_id 
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id AND pim.player_id = r.striker_id 
JOIN Matches AS m2 ON m.match_id = m2.match_id 
WHERE m2.match_date LIKE '%T20%' AND pim.team_name = r.batting_team AND r.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND pim.team_name IN (SELECT batting_team FROM Deliveries GROUP BY batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type = 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) AND m2.match_winner = r.batting_team GROUP BY team;

question: Which player scored the highest runs on the losing side while batting in 2 innings, and what was the difference between their score and the highest single-innings losing score in the entire table?
gold_sql: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayersWith2Innings AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2), TopPlayer AS (SELECT p.player_name, pw.total_runs FROM PlayersWith2Innings pw JOIN Players p ON pw.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY pw.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1), HighestSingleLossingInnings AS (SELECT MAX(innings_runs) AS max_single_innings FROM LosingSideInnings) SELECT tp.player_name, tp.total_runs AS two_innings_losing_total, hs.max_single_innings AS highest_single_innings_losing, (tp.total_runs - hs.max_single_innings) AS difference FROM TopPlayer tp CROSS JOIN HighestSingleLossingInnings hs;
generated_sql:
WITH two_innings_run_category AS (
  SELECT 
    P.player_name,
    SUM(D.runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM 
    Deliveries D
  JOIN 
    PlayerInMatch PM ON D.match_id = PM.match_id AND D.batting_team = PM.team_name AND PM.player_id = (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_id = D.striker_id)
  JOIN 
    Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
  JOIN 
    Players P ON P.player_id = D.striker_id
  WHERE 
    M.match_winner != D.batting_team AND M.inning = 1 AND D.inning = 1 OR M.match_winner != D.batting_team AND M.inning = 2 AND D.inning = 2
  AND D.wides = 0 AND D.noballs = 0 AND M.result_margin = -1 AND D.match_id IN (
    SELECT match_id FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id ORDER BY SUM(runs_scored) DESC LIMIT 1
  )
  GROUP BY P.player_name
)
SELECT 
  p.player_name,
  ti.total_runs,
  (SELECT MAX(D.runs_scored) FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE M.match_winner != D.batting_team AND M.inning = 1) - p.total_runs AS diff
FROM 
  two_innings_run_category p
JOIN (
    SELECT 
      P.player_name, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM 
      Deliveries D
    JOIN 
      PlayerInMatch PM ON D.match_id = PM.match_id AND D.batting_team = PM.team_name AND PM.player_id = (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_id = D.striker_id)
    JOIN 
      Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
    JOIN 
      Players P ON P.player_id = D.striker_id
    WHERE 
      M.match_winner != D.batting_team AND D.inning = 1 AND D.wides = 0 AND D.noballs = 0 AND M.result_margin = -1
    GROUP BY P.player_name
  ) AS single_innings_run_category s ON p.player_name != s.player_name
ORDER BY p.total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: పూర్తయిన T20I ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో అత్యధిక వ్యక్తిగత స్కోరుతో చివరి వరకు బ్యాటింగ్ చేసిన ఆటగాడు ఎవరు? పరుగులు, జట్టు మొత్తం స్కోరు, ప్రత్యర్థి జట్టు మరియు తేదీని తెలపండి.
gold_sql: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs AS runs, it.team_total, it.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY ps.player_runs DESC LIMIT 1;

JOIN deliveries d ON P.player_id = d.striker_id OR P.player_id = d.non_striker_id

AND (d.match_id = calcements.match_id AND calcementsbattingteam = d.batting_team AND calcements.match_date = M.match_date )

question: हारने वाली टीम की दूसरी पारी में बल्लेबाज़ी करते हुए सबसे अधिक रन किस खिलाड़ी ने बनाए, और उसका स्कोर पूरे तालिका में हारने वाली टीम के सर्वाधिक व्यक्तिगत स्कोर से कितना कम या ज़्यादा था?
gold_sql: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayersWith2Innings AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2), TopPlayer AS (SELECT p.player_name, pw.total_runs FROM PlayersWith2Innings pw JOIN Players p ON pw.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY pw.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1), HighestSingleLossingInnings AS (SELECT MAX(innings_runs) AS max_single_innings FROM LosingSideInnings) SELECT tp.player_name, tp.total_runs AS two_innings_losing_total, hs.max_single_innings AS highest_single_innings_losing, (tp.total_runs - hs.max_single_innings) AS difference FROM TopPlayer tp CROSS JOIN HighestSingleLossingInnings hs;

                          WHERE t2.striker_id = t1.player_id AND t2.inning = 2) AS highest_single_innings_losing,
       ( SELECT MAX(t2.runs_scored) 
        FROM Deliveries t2 
        JOIN Matches t3 ON t2.match_id = t3.match_id 
        JOIN PlayerInMatch t4 ON t3.match_id = t4.match_id AND t4.player_id = t2.striker_id

question: In T20Is 2026, what is the instance where a team had 3 batsmen run out in a single innings? Return the team, score, result, opposition, and year.
gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_outs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, CASE WHEN m.match_winner = i.batting_team THEN 'Won' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL THEN 'No Result' ELSE 'Lost' END AS result, i.bowling_team AS opposition, strftime('%Y', m.match_date) AS year FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.run_outs = 3 LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_outs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, CASE WHEN m.match_winner = i.batting_team THEN 'Won' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL THEN 'No Result' ELSE 'Lost' END AS result, i.bowling_team AS opposition, strftime('%Y', m.match_date) AS year FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.run_outs = 3 LIMIT 1;

gold_sql: WITH MatchAggregates AS (SELECT match_id, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id) SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.match_date, ma.total_runs AS match_aggregate, ROUND(ma.total_runs * 6.0 / ma.legal_balls, 2) AS run_rate FROM MatchAggregates ma JOIN Matches m ON ma.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY ma.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1;

question: T20I ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿਹੜੇ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼-ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ ਜੋੜੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਆਊਟ ਹਨ, ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ ਦੀ ਔਸਤ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerBatterStats AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.striker_id AS batter_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.striker_id) SELECT pb.player_name AS bowler, pb2.player_name AS batter, bbs.dismissals, ROUND(CAST(bbs.runs AS FLOAT) / bbs.dismissals, 2) AS batting_average FROM BowlerBatterStats bbs JOIN Players pb ON bbs.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Players pb2 ON bbs.batter_id = pb2.player_id WHERE bbs.dismissals > 0 ORDER BY bbs.dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  D1.bowler_id AS bowler,
  D1.striker_id AS batter,
  COUNT(DISTINCT FD1.delivery_id) AS dismissals,
  (COUNT(DISTINCT D1.delivery_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT F2.delivery_id) / 2) / COUNT(DISTINCT F2.delivery_id) AS batting_average
FROM Deliveries D1
JOIN FielderDismissals F1 ON D1.delivery_id = F1.delivery_id
JOIN Deliveries D2 ON D1.match_id = D2.match_id AND D1.inning = D2.inning AND D1.over_number = D2.over_number AND D1.ball_number = (D2.ball_number - 1)
JOIN FielderDismissals F2 ON D2.delivery_id = F2.delivery_id
WHERE D1.extra_runs = 0
AND D1.noballs = 0
AND (D1.wicket_type != 'run out' AND D1.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' AND D1.wicket_type != 'obstructing the field')
AND D1.match_winner = ' runners’
AND D1.season LIKE '%T20%' AND D1.team1 LIKE '%I%' AND D1.team2 LIKE '%I%' AND D1.stage = 'T20I'
GROUP BY D1.bowler_id, D1.striker_id

gold_sql: WITH BowlerBatterStats AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.striker_id AS batter_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.striker_id) SELECT pb.player_name AS bowler, pb2.player_name AS batter, bbs.dismissals, ROUND(CAST(bbs.runs AS FLOAT) / bbs.dismissals, 2) AS batting_average FROM BowlerBatterStats bbs JOIN Players pb ON bbs.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Players pb2 ON bbs.batter_id = pb2.player_id WHERE bbs.dismissals > 0 ORDER BY bbs.dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;

question: In T20Is, which match holds the record for the highest match aggregate, and what was the run rate of that match?
gold_sql: WITH MatchAggregates AS (SELECT match_id, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id) SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.match_date, ma.total_runs AS match_aggregate, ROUND(ma.total_runs * 6.0 / ma.legal_balls, 2) AS run_rate FROM MatchAggregates ma JOIN Matches m ON ma.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY ma.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    t1.team1, 
    t1.team2, 
    t1.match_date, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN t1.team1 = t1.team1 THEN t2.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN t1.team2 = t1.team1 THEN t2.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS match_aggregate, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN t1.team1 = t1.team1 THEN t2.runs_scored ELSE 0 END + t2.extra_runs) / ((SUM(CASE WHEN t1.team1 = t1.team2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN t1.team2 = t1.team2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 6) AS run_rate
FROM Matches AS t1
JOIN Deliveries AS t2 ON t1.match_id = t2.match_id

question: In T20Is, which bowler-batter combination has the most dismissals, and what is the batter's average against that bowler?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerBatterStats AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.striker_id AS batter_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.striker_id) SELECT pb.player_name AS bowler, pb2.player_name AS batter, bbs.dismissals, ROUND(CAST(bbs.runs AS FLOAT) / bbs.dismissals, 2) AS batting_average FROM BowlerBatterStats bbs JOIN Players pb ON bbs.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Players pb2 ON bbs.batter_id = pb2.player_id WHERE bbs.dismissals > 0 ORDER BY bbs.dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;

    b.name AS bowler,
    p.name AS batter,
    SUM(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS dismissals,
    ROUND(SUM(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) / (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM Deliveries d
        JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
        JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON m.match_id = pm.match_id AND p.player_id = pm.player_id
        JOIN Matches t ON p.player_id = (
            SELECT pi.player_id
            FROM PlayerInMatch pi
            JOIN Matches m ON pi.match_id = m.match_id
            WHERE m.season = 'T20I' AND m.match_date = (
                SELECT MAX(match_date)
                FROM Deliveries d
                JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
                JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON m.match_id = pm.match_id AND p.player_id = pm.player_id
            )
        )
    ), 2) AS batting_average
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON m.match_id = pm.match_id AND d.striker_id = pm.player_id
JOIN Players b ON d.bowler_id = b.player_id
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id
WHERE m.season = 'T20I' AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY b.player_id, p.player_id
ORDER BY dismissals DESC

gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team) SELECT p.player_name, bi.innings_runs AS score, bi.batting_team AS team, CASE WHEN m.team1 = bi.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition, m.match_date FROM BatterInnings bi JOIN Players p ON bi.player_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON bi.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Watson%' ORDER BY bi.innings_runs DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What are the most T20I wins by a team against an opposition at a single venue without suffering a defeat?
gold_answer: ["('England', 'West Indies', 'County Ground', 8)", "('India', 'Bangladesh', 'Sylhet International Cricket Stadium', 6)", "('New Zealand', 'Zimbabwe', 'Harare Sports Club', 5)", "('Pakistan', 'Zimbabwe', 'Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium', 5)"]

  M.team2 AS team,

question: In T20Is, how many times has a team scored 220+ when the opposition used only five bowlers and still lost the match? Return the teams, scores, and oppositions.
gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id) AS bowlers_used FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT COUNT(*) OVER() AS grand_total_instances, i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.total_score >= 220 AND i.bowlers_used = 5 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC;
generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT delivery.match_id) AS grand_total_instances, 
       M1.team1 AS team, 
       D1.runs_scored AS score, 
       M2.team2 AS opposition, 
       D1.match_date AS match_date
FROM Deliveries D1
JOIN Matches M1 ON D1.match_id = M1.match_id
JOIN Matches M2 ON M1.match_id = M2.match_id
WHERE D1.match_id IN (
  SELECT D.match_id
  FROM Deliveries D
  JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id
  WHERE M.stage = 'T20I'
  AND M.match_winner != M.team2
  AND D.wides = 0
  AND D.noballs = 0
  AND D.inning = 1
  AND D.bowling_team IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT D2.bowling_team
    FROM Deliveries D2
    JOIN Matches M2 ON D2.match_id = M2.match_id
    WHERE M2.team1 = M2.team2
    GROUP BY D2.bowling_team
    HAVING COUNT(D2.bowling_team) = 5
  )
)
AND M1.match_winner != M2.team2
AND D1.runs_scored = 220
GROUP BY D1.match_id

question: टी20I में जापान के लिए दर्ज सबसे बड़ी साझेदारी कौन-सी है, और वह किस विकेट के लिए थी?
gold_sql: WITH DeliveryWithWicketsBefore AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, striker_id, non_striker_id, delivery_id, runs_scored + extra_runs AS ball_runs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wickets_before FROM Deliveries), Partnerships AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before, SUM(ball_runs) AS partnership_runs, MIN(delivery_id) AS start_id FROM DeliveryWithWicketsBefore GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before) SELECT p1.player_name || ' & ' || p2.player_name AS partners, ps.partnership_runs AS runs, (ps.wickets_before + 1) AS wicket, m.match_date FROM Partnerships ps JOIN DeliveryWithWicketsBefore dwb ON ps.start_id = dwb.delivery_id JOIN Players p1 ON dwb.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON dwb.non_striker_id = p2.player_id JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id WHERE ps.batting_team = 'Japan' ORDER BY ps.partnership_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  partnership.runs AS partners, 
  partnership.runs, 
  partnership.wicket AS wicket, 
  m.match_date 
FROM 
  (SELECT 
     striker_id AS player1, 
     non_striker_id AS player2, 
     SUM(r.runs_scored) AS runs, 
     CASE 
       WHEN COUNT(CASE 
                     WHEN d.wicket_type IN ('bowled', 'lbw', 'caught') THEN 1
                   END) THEN 'caught' 
       WHEN COUNT(CASE 
                     WHEN d.wicket_type IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1
                   END) THEN 'run out' 
       WHEN COUNT(CASE 
                     WHEN d.wicket_type IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1
                   END) THEN 'retired hurt' 
       WHEN COUNT(CASE 
                     WHEN d.wicket_type IN ('obstructing the field') THEN 1
                   END) THEN 'obstructing the field' 
       ELSE 'bowled'
     END AS wicket 
    FROM 
     Deliveries d 
    JOIN 
     Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id 
    JOIN 
     PlayerInMatch pim1 ON d.striker_id = pim1.player_id AND pim1.team_name = m.team1 
    JOIN 
     PlayerInMatch pim2 ON d.non_striker_id = pim2.player_id AND pim2.team_name = m.team1 
    WHERE 
     d.match_id = m.match_id AND (m.team1 = 'JAPAN' OR m.team2 = 'JAPAN') 
    GROUP BY 
     striker_id, non_striker_id, m.match_id 
    HAVING 
     SUM(r.runs_scored) = (SELECT 
                             MAX(r.runs_scored) 
                           FROM 
                            Deliveries r 
                           JOIN 
                            Matches m ON r.match_id = m.match_id 
                           WHERE 
                            m.match_id = r.match_id AND (m.team1 = 'JAPAN' OR m.team2 = 'JAPAN')) 
  ) partnership 
JOIN 
  Matches m ON partnership.match_id = m.match_id AND (m.team1 = 'JAPAN' OR m.team2 = 'JAPAN')

question: In T20Is, SR Watson scored the highest individual runs on the losing side. What was his score, which team did he represent, and who was the opposition?
gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team) SELECT p.player_name, bi.innings_runs AS score, bi.batting_team AS team, CASE WHEN m.team1 = bi.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition, m.match_date FROM BatterInnings bi JOIN Players p ON bi.player_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON bi.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Watson%' ORDER BY bi.innings_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score,
    tm1.team_name AS team,
    CASE 
        WHEN d.batting_team = t2.team1 THEN t1.team_name 
        ELSE t2.team1
    END AS opposition,
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', m.match_date) AS match_date
FROM Deliveries d
LEFT JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
LEFT JOIN PlayerInMatch him ON p.player_id = him.player_id AND him.match_id = m.match_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT player_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt 
    FROM Deliveries dr 
    WHERE dr.batting_team = 'Australia' 
    AND dr.delivery_id IN (
        SELECT delivery_id 
        FROM Deliveries 
        WHERE batting_team = 'Australia' 
        AND extras = 0 
        AND wide = 0 
        AND noball = 0 
        ANDversepowerplay = 0) 
    GROUP BY dr.striker_id
    HAVING cnt > 1 
) AS abh IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN Matches t1 ON STRFTIME('%Y-%M-%d', t1.match_date) = STRFTIME('%Y-%M-%d', m.match_date) AND t1.team1 = 'Australia'
LEFT JOIN Matches t2 ON STRFTIME('%Y-%M-%d', t2.match_date) = STRFTIME('%Y-%M-%d', m.match_date) AND t2.team2 = 'Australia' 
WHERE d.batting_team = t2.team1 
AND m.result_type = 'Loss'
AND m.stage = 'T20I'
GROUP BY m.match_id
ORDER BY SUM(d.runs_scored) DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_answer: ["('England', 'West Indies', 'County Ground', 8)", "('India', 'Bangladesh', 'Sylhet International Cricket Stadium', 6)", "('New Zealand', 'Zimbabwe', 'Harare Sports Club', 5)", "('Pakistan', 'Zimbabwe', 'Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium', 5)"]
