  T1.team AS team,
  T1.opponent AS opponent,
  T1.venue AS venue,
  COUNT(T3.match_id) AS wins
FROM 
  ( SELECT 
      team1 AS team,
      team2 AS opponent,
      venue
    FROM 
      Matches
    WHERE 
      stage = 'T20I'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
      team2 AS team,
      team1 AS opponent,
      venue
    FROM 
      Matches
    WHERE 
      stage = 'T20I'
  ) AS T1
INNER JOIN 
  Matches AS T2
ON 
  T1.team = T2.team1
INNER JOIN 
  ( SELECT 
      match_id,
      player_of_match_id,
      striker_id
    FROM 
      Deliveries
    WHERE 
      inning = 1
      AND extras = 0
  ) AS T3
ON 
  T2.match_id = T3.match_id
INNER JOIN 
  ( SELECT 
      match_id,
      MAX(winning_team) AS team
    FROM 
      Matches
    WHERE 
      stage = 'T20I'
    GROUP BY 
      match_id
  ) AS T4
ON 
  T4.match_id = T2.match_id
GROUP BY 
  T1.team, T1.opponent, T1.venue

question: T20I లలో, తమ కెరీర్‌లో ఒక్కసారి కూడా డకౌట్ కాకుండా 30కి పైగా ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లు ఆడిన ఆటగాళ్లలో, అత్యధిక స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఎవరిది? ఆ ఆటగాడి పేరు, జట్టు, స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ మరియు ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లను తెలపండి
gold_sql: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_dismissed FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 AND SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0), PlayerTeam AS (SELECT player_id, team_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id, team_name) SELECT p.player_name, pt.team_name AS team, ROUND(ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls, 2) AS strike_rate, ps.innings FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id JOIN PlayerTeam pt ON ps.player_id = pt.player_id AND pt.rn = 1 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT T2.player_name, 
       T1.team_name, 
       CAST(T4.total_runs AS REAL) / T4.total_balls * 100 AS strike_rate, 
       T4.innings
FROM PlayerInMatch T1
JOIN FielderDismissals T3 ON T3.fielder_id = T1.player_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE STRIkker_id = T3.fielder_id OR non_striker_id = T3.fielder_id)
JOIN (SELECT T1.player_id,
             T1.team_name,
             SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type != 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS innings,
             SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type != 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * SUM(T2.runs_scored + T2.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
             SUM(T2.ball_number * (CASE WHEN T2.ball_number = (T2.over_number * 6) + 1 THEN SUM(run_count) + SUM(extras_count) ELSE SUM(run_count) + SUM(extras_count) + 1 END)) AS total_balls
      FROM Deliveries AS T2
      JOIN (
          SELECT T1.match_id,
                 T1.striker_id,
                 T1.runs_scored,
                 T1.ball_number,
                 T1.extra_runs,
                 CASE
                     WHEN T1.ball_number = T1.over_number * 6 + 1 THEN 1
                     ELSE 0
                 END AS run_count,
                 CASE
                     WHEN T1.extras = 1 THEN 1
                     ELSE 0
                 END AS extras_count
        ) T3 ON T2.striker_id = T3.striker_id
        JOIN (
            SELECT T1.match_id,
                   T1.bowler_id,
                   T1.runs_scored,
                   T1.ball_number,
                   T1.extra_runs
            ) T4 ON T2.bowler_id = T4.bowler_id
        WHERE T2.inning = 1 AND T4.wide = 0 AND T4.no_balls = 0
        GROUP BY T2.match_id
        HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type != 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 29
      ) T4 ON T4.player_id = T1.player_id;

question: T20 में Sanju Samson और Jason Holder के बीच आमना-सामना का रिकॉर्ड क्या है?

question: What is the T20 head-to-head record of Sanju Samson against Jason Holder?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  batter AS batter,
  bowler AS bowler,
  SUM(ball_number) AS balls,
  SUM(runs_scored) AS runs,
  SUM(CASE 
    WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1
    ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals,
  ROUND(SUM(runs_scored) * 1.0 / SUM(ball_number), 2) AS average,
  ROUND(SUM(runs_scored) * 100.0 / SUM(ball_number), 2) AS strike_rate
FROM (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN d.striker_id = p.player_id THEN d.striker_id ELSE d.non_striker_id END AS batter,
    CASE 
      WHEN d.striker_id = p.player_id THEN d.bowler_id ELSE d.non_bowler_id END AS bowler,
    d.ball_number AS ball_number,
    d.runs_scored AS runs_scored,
    d.wicket_type AS wicket_type
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
  WHERE batting_team = team1 AND striker_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Sanju Samson') 
  AND bowler_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Jason Holder')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN d.striker_id = p.player_id THEN d.striker_id ELSE d.non_striker_id END AS batter,
    CASE 
      WHEN d.striker_id = p.player_id THEN d.bowler_id ELSE d.non_bowler_id END AS bowler,
    d.ball_number AS ball_number,
    d.runs_scored AS runs_scored,
    d.wicket_type AS wicket_type
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
  WHERE batting_team = team2 AND striker_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Sanju Samson') 
  AND bowler_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Jason Holder')
) T
WHERE extra_runs = 0 AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND batting_team IN (
  SELECT team1 FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN (SELECT team1 FROM Matches WHERE team2 IN (
    SELECT team1 FROM Matches WHERE team2 IN (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Sanju Samson') 
    INTERSECT SELECT team2 FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Jason Holder')
  ) INTERSECT SELECT team2 FROM Matches WHERE team2 IN (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Sanju Samson')) 
  INTERSECT SELECT team2 FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN (SELECT player_id FROM Players WHERE player_name = 'Jason Holder')
)
GROUP BY batter, bowler

  d.batting_team AS `batting_team`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d2.player_id) AS sixes

  SELECT DISTINCT match_id, player_id, 
    CASE

      ELSE 0

) s

  FROM Deliveries

    SELECT match_id 
    FROM Matches 
    WHERE season = '2014'
  )

gold_answer: [['Dwayne Bravo', 66, 4, 38, 'Lord’s', '2009', 'India'], ['Shane Watson', 72, 3, 34, 'Colombo RPS', '2012', 'India'], ['Shane Watson', 51, 3, 26, 'Colombo RPS', '2012', 'Ireland'], ['Marcus Stoinis', 67, 3, 19, 'Bridgetown', '2024', 'Oman'], ['Roston Chase', 52, 3, 12, 'North Sound', '2024', 'South Africa']]

SELECT T1.player_name AS player_name, 
       SUM(DeliveryRuns) AS runs, 
       Wickets AS wickets, 
       RunsConceded AS runs_conceded, 
       T3.venue AS venue, 
       T3.season AS season, 
       T3.team1 AS opponent
FROM (
  SELECT T2.striker_id AS player_id, 
         T2.runs_scored AS DeliveryRuns, 
         T2.inning, 
         T2.over_number, 
         0 AS RunsConceded
  FROM Deliveries T2
  WHERE T2.inning = 1
  INTERSECT
  SELECT T2.non_striker_id AS player_id, 
         T2.runs_scored AS DeliveryRuns, 
         T2.inning, 
         T2.over_number, 
         0 AS RunsConceded
  FROM Deliveries T2
  WHERE T2.inning = 1
) temp
JOIN (
  SELECT delivery_id, T1.striker_id AS player_id, Count(T1.delivery_id) AS Wickets
  FROM Deliveries T1 
  JOIN FielderDismissals T4 ON T1.delivery_id = T4.delivery_id 
  JOIN Players T3 ON T4.fielder_id = T3.player_id 
  WHERE 
     ( T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')) AND
     T1.extra_runs < T1.runs_scored AND 
     T1.wides = T1.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY T1.striker_id

UNION ALL

  SELECT delivery_id, T1.non_striker_id AS player_id, Count(T1.delivery_id) AS Wickets
  FROM Deliveries T1 
  JOIN FielderDismissals T4 ON T1.delivery_id = T4.delivery_id 
  JOIN Players T3 ON T4.fielder_id = T3.player_id 
  WHERE 
     ( T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')) AND
     T1.extra_runs < T1.runs_scored AND 
     T1.wides = T1.noballs = 0
  GROUP BY T1.non_striker_id
) temp2 ON temp.player_id = temp2.player_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch T3 ON T3.player_id = temp.player_id AND T3.match_id = temp2.delivery_id AND T3.team_name = ( SELECT T2.team2 AS team_name

          FROM Deliveries T2

          JOIN Players T3 ON T4.fielder_id = T3.player_id 
          WHERE T3.player_id = temp.player_id AND T2.delivery_id = temp2.delivery_id DELETE FROM T4 
     AND (  T2.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')) AND

question: T20 లో Shimron Hetmyer vs Jasprit Bumrah మధ్య హెడ్-టు-హెడ్ రికార్డు ఏమిటి?

gold_answer: [['Dwayne Bravo', 66, 4, 38, 'Lord’s', '2009', 'India'], ['Shane Watson', 72, 3, 34, 'Colombo RPS', '2012', 'India'], ['Shane Watson', 51, 3, 26, 'Colombo RPS', '2012', 'Ireland'], ['Marcus Stoinis', 67, 3, 19, 'Bridgetown', '2024', 'Oman'], ['Roston Chase', 52, 3, 12, 'North Sound', '2024', 'South Africa']]

SELECT 
  T1.player_name,
  SUM(T2.runs_scored) AS runs,
  COUNT(T2.wicket_type) - COUNT(T3.bowler_id) AS wickets,
  SUM(T2.extra_runs + CASE WHEN T2.wicket_type IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 0 ELSE T3.runs_scored END - T1.result_margin) AS runs_conceded,
  T2.venue,
  T2.season,
  CASE 
    WHEN T2.team1 = T4.team_name THEN T2.team2
    ELSE T2.team1
  END AS opponent
FROM 
  Players AS T1 
  INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.striker_id 
  LEFT JOIN Deliveries AS T3 ON T3.match_id = T2.match_id AND T3.ball_number BETWEEN T2.ball_number AND (SELECT WHERE max(ball_number) FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = T2.match_id) 
  RIGHT JOIN PlayerInMatch AS T4 ON T2.match_id = T4.match_id AND T1.player_id = T4.player_id 
WHERE 
  T2.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = '2026')
  AND T2.ball_number = (SELECT MAX(ball_number) FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = T2.match_id AND team1 = T4.team_name) 
  AND wides = 0 
  AND noballs = 0 
  AND T2.runs_scored >= 40 
  AND T2.inning = 1 AND T4.team_name IN (

  )

generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT 
    p1.player_name AS batter, 
    p2.player_name AS bowler, 
    d.ball_number AS balls, 
    d.runs_scored AS runs, 
    MIN(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN md.fielder_id ELSE NULL END) AS dismissals, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN d.ball_number ELSE NULL END) / 3 AS average, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN d.ball_number ELSE NULL END) * 100 / SUM(d.runs_scored) AS strike_rate
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim1 ON m.match_id = pim1.match_id AND pim1.player_id = d.striker_id AND pim1.team_name = m.team1
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim2 ON m.match_id = pim2.match_id AND pim2.player_id = d.bowler_id AND pim2.team_name = m.team2

JOIN Players p2 ON d.bowler_id = p2.player_id

JOIN Players md ON fd.fielder_id = md.player_id
WHERE m.toss_winner = m.match_winner AND m.result_type = 'win' AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY p1.player_id, p2.player_id

JOIN Players P ON P.player_id = PIM.player_id

GROUP BY P.player_name

question: T20 World Cups में सबसे अधिक छक्के किस कप्तान ने लगाए हैं?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS player_name, 
    SUM(sixes + fours) AS total_sixes
FROM (
    SELECT 
        d.delivery_id,
        IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN w EventType = 'six' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sixes,
        IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN w.EventType = 'four' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fours
    FROM 
        Deliveries d
    JOIN 
        (
            SELECT 
                d.delivery_id,
                (CASE 
                    WHEN obj.sub_type LIKE '%hit6%' THEN 'six' 
                    ELSE NULL 
                END) AS EventType
            FROM 
                Deliveries d
            JOIN 
                FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id
            JOIN 
                (
                    SELECT 
                        delivery_id,
                        CASE 
                            WHEN dismissal_type IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
                            THEN NULL 
                            ELSE dismissal_type 
                        END AS dismissal_type
                    FROM 
                        FielderDismissals
                ) obj ON fd.delivery_id = obj.delivery_id
            WHERE 
                d.wides = 0 
                AND d.noballs = 0
        ) w ON d.delivery_id = w.delivery_id
    WHERE 
        inning = 1 
        AND d.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'T20')
GROUP BY 
    d.delivery_id
).joinplayer
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            m.match_id,
            p.player_name,
            SUM(CASE WHEN d.ball_number = t.balls AND t.bowling_team = m.team1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 
            SUM(CASE WHEN d.ball_number = t.balls AND t.bowling_team = m.team2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes
        FROM 
            Matches m
        JOIN 
            PlayerInMatch pim ON m.match_id = pim.match_id
        JOIN 
            Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id
        JOIN 
            Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
        JOIN 
            Teams t ON m.team1 = t.team_id
        WHERE 
            m.stage = 'T20'
            AND pim.team_name = m.team1
        GROUP BY 
            m.match_id, p.player_id
    ) bowler ON joinplayer.delivery_id = bowler.match_id
JOIN 
    Players cap ON bowler.player_name = cap.player_name
GROUP BY 
    joinplayer.player_name
ORDER BY 
    total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What are the highest combined team totals in a single match in season 2026?
generated_sql:
SELECT team1 AS team1, 
       team2 AS team2, 
       venue AS venue, 
       season AS season, 
       SUM(a.runs_scored) + SUM(b.runs_scored) AS combined_runs
FROM Deliveries a
JOIN Deliveries b ON a.match_id = b.match_id
JOIN Matches c ON c.match_id = a.match_id
WHERE a.inning = 1 
AND b.inning = 2 
AND c.season = '2026' 
GROUP BY team1, team2, venue, season 
ORDER BY combined_runs DESC

question: సీజన్ 2026 లో అత్యధిక వ్యక్తిగత శతకాలు చేసిన ఆటగాళ్ళు ఎవరు?
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) AS hundreds 
FROM Deliveries d 
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id OR d.non_striker_id = p.player_id 
WHERE d.match_id IN (
    SELECT m.match_id 
    FROM Matches m 
    WHERE m.season = '2026' 
) AND 0 < d.ball_number AND d.ball_number <= 120 AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 
GROUP BY p.player_name

       COUNT(D.distinctmatch_id) AS wickets

question: Which bowlers have the most consecutive T20I innings with at least one wicket for Full Member sides?
gold_answer: ["('RP Yadav', 27)", "('AU Rashid', 24)", "('S Lamichhane', 24)", "('ML Schutt', 23)", "('PWH de Silva', 23)", "('CV Varun', 22)", "('S Ecclestone', 20)", "('AR Ramjani', 19)", "('Arshdeep Singh', 18)", "('Al-Amin Hossain', 18)"]
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name AS player_name, max_innings_with_wicket AS max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket
FROM (
  SELECT p.player_name,
         p.player_id,
         m.season,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY d.delivery_id) as rn
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
  WHERE d.batting_team IN ('Full Member', 'Test Fifa')
    AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
) sub
JOIN (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as max_innings_with_wicket, season
  FROM (
    SELECT p.player_name,
           p.player_id,
           m.season,
           SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over (PARTITION BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS 2 PRECEDING) as rb,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY d.delivery_id) as rn
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
    JOIN (
      SELECT distinct player_id
      FROM Deliveries
      JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
      WHERE d.batting_team IN ('Full Member', 'Test Fifa')
        AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
          AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    ) o ON p.player_id = o.player_id
  ) sub2
  GROUP BY player_id, season, rb = 0
) max_wicket on sub.player_id = max_wicket.player_id AND sub.season = max_wicket.season AND sub.rn = max_wicket.rn + 1
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket DESC;

question: What are the top two highest-scoring partnerships at the best run rates in season 2026?
generated_sql:
SELECT runs, run_rate, T1.team1, T2.team2, T.matches.venue AS AS1, T.matches.season 
FROM (
  SELECT T.team1, T.team2, T.venue, T.season, MAX(T.r) AS r, T.runs, T2.score AS s 
  FROM (
    SELECT T1.team1, T1.team2, T1.venue, T1.season, SUM(T2.r) AS r, 
           SUM(T2.runs) AS runs, SUM(T2.runs) / SUM(T2.o) * 6 AS run_rate 
    FROM (
      SELECT team1, team2, venue, season, 
             CASE 
               WHEN inning = 1 THEN balls 
               ELSE balls + (innings_wkts * 6)
             END AS o, 
             runs 
      FROM Deliveries 
      JOIN Matches ON Deliveries.match_id = Matches.match_id 
      WHERE inning = 1 AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 
    ) AS runs 
    JOIN Deliveries ON runs.ball_number = Deliveries.ball_number 
    WHERE bowling_team NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
    GROUP BY team1, team2, venue, season 
  ) AS T 
  JOIN Matches AS T1 ON T.team1 = T1.team1 
  JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T.team2 = T2.team2 AND T.season = T2.season 
  JOIN (
    SELECT T1.team1 AS t1, T2.team2 AS t2, sum(T2.runs) AS score 
    FROM (
      SELECT team1 AS team, 
             CASE 
               WHEN inning = 1 THEN balls 
               ELSE balls + (innings_wkts * 6)
             END AS balls 
      FROM Deliveries 
      JOIN Matches ON Deliveries.match_id = Matches.match_id 
      WHERE inning = 1 AND wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 
    ) AS runs 
    JOIN Deliveries ON runs.ball_number = Deliveries.ball_number 
    WHERE bowling_team NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
    GROUP BY team1, team2 
  ) AS score ON (T.team1, T.team2) IN ((score.t1, score.t2), (score.t2, score.t1)) 
  WHERE T2.score < T.runs AND T1.match_id = T2.match_id 
  GROUP BY T1.match_id, T1.team1, T1.team2 
  ORDER BY r / o DESC 
) AS T 
GROUP BY T1.match_id, T1.team1, T1.team2 
ORDER BY r / o DESC 
LIMIT 2

                              LIMIT 1 OFFSET T2.rowid - 1
                             )
  JOIN Deliveries T4 
    ON T3.striker_id = T4.striker_id 
   AND T3.striker_id =  (SELECT striker_id 
                              FROM Deliveries 
                              ORDER BY match_id 
	                             , over_number 
	                             , ball_number
                              LIMIT 1 OFFSET T2.rowid - 1
                             )
  JOIN PlayerInMatch T5 
    ON T3.match_id = T5.match_id 
   AND T4.striker_id = T5.player_id 
   AND T5.team_name = (SELECT team_name 
                                FROM PlayerInMatch 
                                WHERE PlayerInMatch.match_id = T5.match_id 
                                AND team_name IN (
                                  SELECT team_name 
                                  FROM PlayerInMatch 
                                  WHERE PlayerInMatch.match_id = T1.match_id 
                                  GROUP BY team_name 
                                  HAVING SUM(extra_runs + runs_scored) > 250 
                                ) 
                             )
  JOIN Players T2 
    ON T4.striker_id = T2.player_id 
  WHERE T3.extra_runs = 0 
    AND T3.noballs = 0 
    AND T1.match_winner NOT IN ('null', 'tied')
  WHERE T3.ball_number = (SELECT MAX(ball_number) 
                              FROM Deliveries dr 
                              WHERE dr.match_id = T1.match_id 
                             )
UNION SELECT 
  bowling_team,
  match_date,
  (SELECT 
    SUM(extra_runs + runs_scored) 
    FROM Deliveries dr 
    WHERE dr.match_id = T3.match_id 
      AND dr.ball_number = 7 
      AND dr.wicket_type = 'Bowling'
      AND dr.ball_number NOT IN (
        SELECT ball_number 
        FROM Deliveries dr 
          JOIN T1 ON dr.match_id = T1.match_id 
          WHERE striker_id = (
            SELECT strike_id FROM Deliveries dr2 
          WHERE dr2.striker_id = dr.striker_id 
            AND dr2.ball_number <= 6 
          ORDER BY runScore ASC LIMIT 1)
      )
  ) AS runs_conceded,
  (SELECT 
    SUM(extra_runs + runs_scored) 
    FROM Deliveries dr 
    WHERE dr.match_id = T3.match_id 
      AND dr.ball_number = 7 
      AND dr.wicket_type = 'Bowling'
      AND dr.ball_number NOT IN (
        SELECT ball_number 
        FROM Deliveries dr 
          JOIN T1 ON dr.match_id = T1.match_id 
          WHERE striker_id = (
            SELECT strike_id FROM Deliveries dr2 
          WHERE dr2.striker_id = dr.striker_id 
            AND dr2.ball_number <= 6 
          ORDER BY runScore ASC LIMIT 1)
      ) AS prev_runs
FROM Matches T1
JOIN Deliveries T3 
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id 
 WHERE T1.season='T20I'

question: ਸੀਜ਼ਨ 2026 ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਦੀ ਇੱਕ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਬਾਊਂਡਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਕਿੰਨੀ ਹੈ?
generated_sql:
SELECT T1.bowling_team AS batting_team, COUNT(T1.bowler_id) AS total_boundaries, T2.season, T2.team1 AS opponent 
FROM Deliveries AS T1 
JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id AND T2.match_date LIKE '%2026%' 
WHERE T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 AND T1.bowled = 0 AND T1.lby = 0 AND (T1.runs_scored IN (4,6) OR (T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field'))) 
GROUP BY T1.match_id, T2.season

question: सीज़न 2026 में किसी टीम की एक पारी में सबसे अधिक बाउंड्री की संख्या कितनी है?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  batting_team AS "Batting Team",
  SUM(CASE WHEN extra_runs > 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_boundaries,
  season,
  team2 AS opponent
FROM 
  Deliveries
WHERE 
  wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 AND bowling_team!= batting_team AND season = '2026'
GROUP BY 
  batting_team, season, team2

  total_boundaries DESC

LIMIT 1;

question: What are the highest boundary counts in a team innings in season 2026?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    b1.team_name          AS batting_team, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN w1.type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_boundaries, 
    m.season, 
    m.team2                 AS opponent
FROM Deliveries AS d1 
JOIN Matches AS m      ON d1.match_id = m.match_id 
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS p1 ON d1.match_id = p1.match_id 
JOIN PlayerInMatch AS p2 ON d1.match_id = p2.match_id AND p2.team_name = m.team2 
JOIN Players AS b1     ON d1.batting_team = b1.player_id 
JOIN Players AS w1     ON d1.bowler_id    = w1.player_id 
WHERE m.season = '2026' AND d1.deliveries IN (SELECT d2.delivery_id 
                                              FROM Deliveries AS d2 
                                              WHERE d2.wides = 0 AND d2.noballs = 0 AND d2.wicket_type IN ('four', 'six')) 
GROUP BY b1.team_name, m.season, m.team2
ORDER BY total_boundaries DESC;

question: 2023 నుండి బహుళ జాతీయ T20I టోర్నమెంట్లలో India రికార్డు ఏమిటి?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT M.match_id) FROM Matches M 
      INNER JOIN Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id 
      WHERE season = 2023 AND M.team1 = 'India' AND batting_team = 'India'
    ) AS total_matches,
    ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT M.match_id) FROM Matches M 
      INNER JOIN Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id 
      WHERE season = 2023 AND M.team1 = 'India' AND batting_team = 'India' AND M.match_winner = D.batting_team 
    ) AS wins,
    ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT M.match_id) FROM Matches M 
      INNER JOIN Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id 
      WHERE season = 2023 AND M.team1 = 'India' AND batting_team = 'India' AND M.match_winner != D.batting_team 
    ) AS losses,
    ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT M.match_id) FROM Matches M 
      INNER JOIN Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id 
      WHERE season = 2023 AND M.team1 = 'India' AND batting_team = 'India' AND M.match_winner IS NULL 
    ) AS no_results

    D.batting_team AS batting_team,
    CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 1 AND season = '2026' AND extra_runs = 6 AND match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season = '2026)) as REAL) * 1.0 / 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 1 AND season = '2026') AS sixes,

WITH consecutive_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        D.match_id,
        P.player_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.player_id ORDER BY D.delivery_id) AS score_num,
        SUM(CASE WHEN D.runs_scored > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY P.player_id ORDER BY D.delivery_id) AS max_consecutive_50_plus
    FROM Players P
    JOIN FielderDismissals FD ON P.player_id = FD.fielder_id
    JOIN Deliveries D ON FD.delivery_id = D.delivery_id
),
max_scoring_players AS (
    SELECT 
        player_name,
        MAX(max_consecutive_50_plus) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS max_consecutive_50_plus
    FROM consecutive_scores
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT 
            P1.player_id
        FROM Players P1
        JOIN consecutive_scores CS ON P1.player_id = CS.player_id
        WHERE CS.score_num - CS.max_consecutive_50_plus <= 1
    )
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    max_consecutive_50_plus
FROM max_scoring_players
WHERE player_name IN (
    SELECT 
        MATCH P1.player_name
    FROM max_scoring_players P1
    JOIN max_scoring_players P2 ON P1.max_consecutive_50_plus = P2.max_consecutive_50_plus
    WHERE P1.player_id < P2.player_id
) GROUP BY player_name ORDER BY player_name LIMIT 1
